Shape the future of automotive connectivity - Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTNs) are set to become a cornerstone of the upcoming 6G mobile communication standard. By extending the reach of terrestrial networks, they enable ubiquitous and resilient communication and will play a key role in next-generation vehicle communication units, ensuring seamless and robust connectivity for the automotive future.
As a PhD candidate with us, you will conduct intensive research on future satellite-to-vehicle communication solutions based on innovative 6G networks.
You will develop and implement advanced algorithms for handover mechanisms between terrestrial and non-terrestrial networks in order to ensure continuous and reliable connectivity for vehicles.

You will actively contribute your research results to ongoing 3GPP studies and working groups, with the aim of filing patents and integrating your contributions into future releases.
As part of the publicly funded project "6G-Coverage", you will work closely with universities and partner companies and network with leading experts.

As part of your thesis, you will analyze frequently recurring design tasks and develop modular, parametrically controllable feature groups in Creo. data.advertised_job_title: Master's Thesis: Robust Identification of Composite Electric Drive Models — Identifiability, Sensitivity & Excitation Analysis (f/m/div.)
data.job_description:
Job Description
During your thesis, you will delve into physics-based models of electric drives as well as our Python component library and at the same time review the current literature on robust system identification and design of experiments. In addition, you will develop innovative robustness diagnostics for our existing identification pipeline – taking into account parameter identifiability, sensitivity and convergence behavior – and implement and quantify suitable countermeasures. In addition, you will analyze the excitation content of existing datasets, evaluate relevant criteria and link these findings to the achievable identification quality. You will comprehensively evaluate the approach you have developed using a practical benchmark use case. In addition, you will document and present your research results in a clear and understandable way. Finally, you will expand the approach to address partially observable effects resulting from states that cannot be directly measured, such as temperatures. 

Qualifications
Education: 
Master's degree in cybernetics, engineering, mathematics, computer science or comparable
Experience and knowledge: 
Basic knowledge of dynamical systems and differential equations; very good knowledge of Python programming; understanding of the physics of electrical machines; optional: experience with MATLAB/Simulink to interact with existing simulation models; optional: knowledge of machine learning as well as frameworks for automatic differentiation (JAX or PyTorch)
Personality and way of working: 
You work independently and systematically on complex issues and have strong analytical skills so that you can grasp and solve problems precisely
Working Mode: 
Presence in the office required

Very good knowledge of English

data.advertised_job_title: Master's thesis on the automation and optimization of test bench commissioning through intelligent generation and management of maneuver files
data.job_description:
Job Description
How does a simple test specification become a complete test bench application? And why do repetitive manual activities still require valuable time in engineering today? In this master's thesis, you will develop intelligent tools that sustainably simplify everyday work in test bench development. You will analyze real processes, identify automation potentials and develop software solutions for the automated creation, testing and management of test bench files. This creates direct added value for productivity, quality and everyday laboratory life. 
As part of your thesis, you will analyze the current commissioning process of maneuver files for brake control system test benches with the help of a value stream analysis, identify manual activities and derive automation potential. 
When analyzing existing auxiliary tools, scripts and process steps in the laboratory environment, you will evaluate their potential and develop a holistic digitization concept from them. 
You will design and develop a generator for the automated creation of maneuver files based on existing target specifications and defined sets of rules. 
In addition, you will develop an intuitive tool for analyzing, visualizing, and bulk editing large amounts of maneuver files. 
To ensure the quality and consistency of generated test bench files, you will implement appropriate testing and validation mechanisms. 
Finally, you will test and optimize the developed solution together with users in laboratory operation and evaluate the productivity gain achieved. 
You will implement all of this in direct cooperation with the teams from test bench development and laboratory operations, gain insights into real engineering processes and develop productive tools with immediate benefits for daily work.

Job Description
Are you ready to shape the future of modern mobility systems by taking ownership of digital ASIC design? As a Senior ASIC Digital Lead, you take technical responsibility for the digital design scope across complex ASIC projects. You ensure a consistent and high-quality implementation from specification to integration, actively contributing to the design while driving alignment across all stakeholders and supporting robust DFT and test strategies.
In this position, you take technical responsibility for the digital design scope in ASIC projects, coordinating specification, development, and integration across all stakeholders. You align requirements, structure execution, and drive key technical decisions to ensure a robust and consistent digital implementation.
You act as the central coordination point for all digital design activities, while also contributing hands-on to implementation, ensuring practical feasibility and high-quality results.
Based on system requirements and project objectives, you derive, consolidate, and implement the digital design concept, ensuring consistency across all development phases.
You ensure that DFT and ATPG aspects are properly integrated into the design within the project, planning and aligning activities and ensuring the achievement of defined coverage targets.
Last but not least, you take project-spanning responsibility for the ATPG/DFT flow, ensuring its stable operation, continuous improvement, and consistent application across projects. By analyzing test patterns, silicon data, and defect signatures, you identify root causes and drive targeted improvements in design, test quality, and methodologies. You further enhance efficiency and standardization by developing automation solutions and integrating new tools and methods.

Qualifications
Education:
completed university studies in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a comparable subject
​​​​​​
Experience and Knowledge:
several years of experience in digital ASIC development, including top-level integration; proven experience as Digital Lead in project environments; strong expertise in ATPG, test methodologies, coverage analysis, and ATPG tools, including methodology and flow development in digital and ATPG domains; experience in failure analysis using pattern and silicon data; solid understanding of digital verification and interface validation; strong scripting skills (Python, Tcl, or shell); experience in coordinating external development partners and cross-functional teams

you approach tasks in a structured, responsible, and goal-oriented manner; you possess strong coordination and communication skills, enabling you to effectively drive technical topics across organizational boundaries

Are you motivated by the challenge of shaping the future of automotive technology with pioneering microelectronics? Are you excited about translating complex concepts into high-performance analog and mixed-signal circuits that enable the next generation of electrification and smart power solutions? Then join our team and take on a key role as an architect of innovative ASICs – with a direct impact on the performance and reliability of tomorrow's vehicles. 
In this position, you will design and develop high-performance analog and mixed-signal circuits for complex automotive ASICs, especially for electrification and smart power applications. You will be responsible for the entire development process – from specification and architecture definition to implementation, verification and characterization to product release. You will analyze and optimize analog architectures in terms of performance, robustness, quality, cost and manufacturability and ensure first-class results. Working closely with layout, verification, testing, product engineering, and application teams, you will ensure a successful first-pass silicon run and support ASIC qualification and problem solving throughout the product lifecycle. You will identify, analyze, and reduce design risks in terms of functionality, reliability, EMC, and ESD robustness. At the same time, you will provide technical coaching to junior engineers and actively promote knowledge sharing and the development of best practices. 
Last but not least, you will work with international development teams, customers and cross-divisional stakeholders and actively contribute to innovation activities, methodological improvements and the design of future semiconductor technologies for the automotive industry.

With your expertise, you will be the central contact person for the housing and real estate industry. You will build and actively maintain networks in order to identify projects at an early stage and position the Buderus brand as a leading partner. 
You will communicate regularly with your customers, record their individual needs and define tailor-made system solutions. In addition, you will independently develop concept ideas for complex systems, create technology comparisons and present the entire Buderus portfolio. 
Close cooperation with the technical back office, branches, partners and service is essential. You will support space sales, negotiate framework agreements and offers, analyse technical and economic feasibility and compile all relevant project information in the CRM system in accordance with the specifications. 
They represent Buderus as a trusted partner with relevant associations in the housing industry. This includes active participation in trade fairs, exhibitions, customer seminars and other events to strengthen the brand presence.

data.job_description:
Job Description
The aim is to investigate how industrial customers will communicate their interest or need for technical products and solutions in the next 5 to 10 years. The focus is on the most likely forms of communication and interaction between customers, manufacturers, sales, engineering, procurement systems and AI agents. 
As part of your thesis, you will actively shape the future of customer interaction in the industrial B2B environment. 
Your analysis provides 2-3 concrete future scenarios for the future customer journey and the associated demand communication. 
Based on this, you will design a rough process model that takes into account the skills, data, systems and roles of AI agents. 
You will work at the interface of strategic planning and technological innovation. 
Your findings help us to develop forward-looking concepts for our customer communication.

data.advertised_job_title: Mandatory Internship Data Engineering – CAD Visualization
data.job_description:
Job Description
In our team, we deal with remanufacturing as a sub-area of the circular economy. The dismantling of end-of-life products is a central aspect of this. Work instructions for manual disassembly can be issued via an Operator Guided Instruction System (OGIS). The aim is to create this OGIS automatically on the basis of a CAD model and a disassembly sequence. 
In this exciting role, you will develop a powerful Python pipeline for the clear visualization of disassembly sequences directly from CAD data. 
You choose the most suitable visualization tool on your own responsibility, using modern interfaces such as the Teamcenter API, PLM Vis WEB or ParaView. 
Here, you will design a clever strategy to display different views of component groups in the CAD model via the pipeline and to highlight the components to be dismantled. 
For seamless data mapping, you will develop a structured procedure for harmonizing component IDs between the CAD model and the manufacturing data. 
Finally, you design a user-friendly graphical interface with Streamlit that gives the user intuitive control of the entire pipeline. 

Qualifications
Education: 
Degree in data engineering, mechanical engineering, environmental engineering, industrial engineering, computer science or comparable with good academic performance
Experience and know-how: 
Initial experience with Python; Acquired practical experience from internships or apprenticeships desirable; ideally knowledge of CAD

data.advertised_job_title: Master's thesis on the digitization of the commissioning process of test benches through value stream mapping and workflow automation
data.job_description:
Job Description
Do you not only want to develop software, but also sustainably improve a real engineering process? In this master's thesis, you will analyze the cooperation of international development teams and develop a digital solution that creates transparency, reduces manual activities and makes the commissioning of complex test systems more efficient. Your results have the potential to be used in development and test teams worldwide. 
As part of your thesis, you will analyze the existing commissioning process of test benches with the help of a value stream map, identify media breaks as well as manual activities and derive optimization potential. 
When evaluating suitable low-code and no-code technologies to digitize engineering workflows, you consider scalability, maintainability, and ease of use. 
You will design and develop a digital workflow solution for the continuous support of task planning, implementation, evaluation and documentation during commissioning. 
In addition, you will automate data and information flows between engineering systems, test bench networks and analysis tools. 
To transparently track commissioning progress, you will develop intuitive dashboards as well as automated status and release overviews. 
Finally, you will validate the developed solution in a real laboratory environment and derive further optimization measures based on user feedback. 
You will implement all of this in close cooperation with specialists from test bench development and software development, gaining a wide range of insights into process analysis, software development and user interviews within ongoing development projects. 

Qualifications
Education: 
Master's degree in computer science, business informatics, software engineering, computer engineering or comparable
Experience and know-how: 
Knowledge of software development and data modeling using Python or C# 
Basic understanding of modern web and cloud applications
Affinity for process digitization and workflow automation
Handling of the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate), databases, SharePoint, Microsoft Lists or comparable automation solutions
Basics in the field of lean management or process analysis
Confident handling of MS Office
Personality and way of working:

data.advertised_job_title: Consultant (m/f/div.) in the field of impact - monitoring, evaluation, adaptation and learning in Stuttgart or Berlin
data.job_description:
Job Description
For our team "Foresight, Impact, Strategy" we are looking for a
Consultant (m/f/div.) in the field of impact - monitoring, evaluation, adaptation and learning in Stuttgart or Berlin
As a foundation, we work under volatile, uncertain, complex and sometimes contradictory conditions. This requires a high degree of adaptability in order to remain effective, sustainable and relevant. Our team designs and supports foresight and impact processes as well as the Foundation's overall strategy work. We are currently further developing our approach and approach to impact monitoring in a project that will run until late summer 2027. Management and content design of this project as part of a two-person project management team are a central part of the task. 
Your tasks: 
They further develop the Foundation's impact orientation and monitoring, including suitable monitoring and evaluation instruments
They design reporting formats for the foundation's committees. 
You will advise and support subject areas and subsidiaries in the conception and implementation of MEAL and develop and moderate internal workshops on this subject. 
They design exchange formats and training courses on monitoring, evaluation, adaptation and learning and offer them to colleagues of the foundation. 
You will maintain professional networks on the topic of impact orientation and expand them in a targeted manner. 
You will help shape the portfolio of tasks of the entire team, especially the connection between foresight and impact monitoring. 

Qualifications
Your profile: 
Several years of experience in funding organizations, in the non-profit sector or in consulting, including the evaluation of charitable projects and grants. 
Very good knowledge of qualitative and quantitative social science methods and in dealing with large amounts of data; Knowledge of PowerBI, QDA tools and interest in AI-supported data collection and analysis methods is an advantage. 
Knowledge of project management and experience in managing large projects with the participation of different stakeholder groups
Interest in organizational development and the foundation's funding topics. 
Strong communication and moderation skills and the ability to change perspectives
Very good knowledge of German and English

data.advertised_job_title: Master's Thesis: AI-based Control of Power Electronics (f/m/div.)
data.job_description:
Job Description
Modern power electronic systems, especially AC/DC and DC/DC converters, form the indispensable backbone of tomorrow's technology landscape: In e-mobility, they enable ultra-fast, highly efficient onboard charging systems as well as robust power delivery. In robotics, they drive highly dynamic, precise actuators and electric drives required for collaborative and autonomous systems. In data centers, they ensure maximum energy efficiency, high power density, and uninterrupted operation. To meet the stringent efficiency and installation space requirements of these applications, modern power electronics increasingly relies on advanced soft-switching topologies. While these topologies significantly reduce switching losses and maximize power density, they have strong nonlinear dynamics. At the same time, cost and space optimization require smaller energy storage components (capacitors and inductors), which further increases system instability and complex dynamic behavior. Traditional linear control methods (such as standard PI controllers) struggle to maintain optimal performance under these demanding conditions. 
This master's thesis aims to investigate, compare, and implement next-generation closed-loop control algorithms to master these nonlinearities and further push the power limits of converters. As part of your thesis, you will select the most promising control concept and develop a customized control strategy based on an already existing simulation model of our next-generation charger converter topologies. You will investigate advanced closed-loop control methods suitable for highly nonlinear power electronic systems, with a focus on Model Predictive Control (MPC), neural network-based rule architectures, and reinforcement learning (RL) approaches for power converters. In addition, you will implement the developed control algorithm in a simulation environment (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, Python, or PLECS). In addition, you will validate and benchmark the control concept under realistic operating conditions, evaluating the transient behavior, efficiency, and stability compared to established reference controllers. You will analyze and compare the identified control strategies in terms of computational effort, dynamics, robustness against parameter changes, and suitability for real-time implementation. Finally, you will create the documentation and present the results. 

Qualifications
Education: 
Master's degree in electrical engineering, control engineering, mechatronics, cybernetics, computer science or a comparable qualification
Experience and knowledge: 
Sound knowledge of control systems (state space, nonlinear control or predictive modern control methods); Confident use of simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink and/or Python with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch; Knowledge of power electronics (AC/DC and DC/DC converters) is an advantage
Personality and way of working: 
You are a goal-oriented and motivated person with a solution-oriented mindset
Working model: 
We offer you the opportunity to work in a hybrid working model
Enthusiasm: 
High motivation to work on future-oriented research at the interface of power electronics and intelligent control systems (machine learning, reinforcement learning)
Languages: 
Fluent in English or German

Additional information
Start: by prior arrangement  
Duration: 6 months  

The prerequisite for this thesis is enrollment at a college/university. Please attach your curriculum vitae, your transcript of records, the examination regulations and, if necessary, a valid work and residence permit.   

Diversity and inclusion are not just trends for us, but are firmly anchored in our corporate culture. Therefore, we welcome all applications – regardless of gender, age, disability, religion, ethnic origin or sexual identity.

data.advertised_job_title: Junior Managers Program (Trainee) - Start your Leadership Journey in Supply Chain Management
data.job_description:
Job Description
Ready to shape global material and product flows?
We are looking for logistics-oriented master’s graduates with a drive to make a difference, who will redefine Bosch's supply chain in our Junior Managers Program. If you are passionate about data, think strategically, and are eager to build an outstanding leadership career, we want to hear from you.​
Over an intensive 12 to 24-month journey, you will become part of one of the most critical systems of a global enterprise: the supply chain. You will rotate through various departments—in Germany and worldwide—and dive deep into the world of data, processes, and global networks. Your mission: master complexity and rethink supply chains.​
You won't just collaborate—you will change things.
You will bring in your own ideas, test new approaches, and directly see the impact of your work on real supply chains.​
What you will learn and develop with us:​
You will learn how global supply chains truly work—and how data, technology, and smart decisions determine success or failure.​
You will actively shape logistics processes and supply chains that move millions of products—efficiently, sustainably, and future-proof.​
You will work with data, digital tools, international teams, and your personal mentor to develop into the next generation of leaders in the supply chain environment.​
Your academic foundation:​
You have graduated with an outstanding (full-time) Master's degree, e.g., in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Informatics, or Business Administration. Topics such as supply chain, data analysis, or digitalization genuinely interest you—not just in theory.​

Qualifications
Your passion for supply chain & data:​
You enjoy understanding complex relationships. Data, processes, and systems are not chaos to you—they are a challenge.​
Your eye for the bigger picture:​
You don't just want to be a part of the system—you want to understand how everything connects and how you can make a real difference.​
Your understanding of human-centric leadership:​
You inspire others, think openly, and enjoy working with diverse people. For you, it's clear: strong teams mean strong performance.​
You think strategically and shape the future:​
You challenge the status quo, bring in your own ideas, and have the drive to actually implement them—especially regarding digitalization, automation, and sustainability.​
Your continuous development:​
You want to grow. Fast. You are curious, learn from challenges, and continuously develop yourself.​
Your language proficiency:
You communicate fluently in English (negotiation level) and possess good German language skills. You have already gained at least three months of international experience.​

Additional Information
Why you will love being part of our community
We are deeply invested in the growth of our team members. We have created an environment where you are supported, valued, and empowered to do your best work.
Mentoring & Sponsoring:
An executive-level mentor will accompany you on your journey, actively support your development, and open doors for your next career steps with us.
A culture of belonging:
From day one, you will become part of a global community of trainees from diverse backgrounds and locations. Build authentic connections beyond formal projects through virtual hangouts, local meetups, or our (global) trainee summits.
Flexible & hybrid working:
We trust you to manage your work in a way that fits your life, with a flexible start date and a permanent employment contract. We offer a hybrid model that combines office and remote collaboration.
Continuous learning:
Benefit from up to 6 rotations across different departments, including an international rotation, supported by a generous budget for your professional development (courses, certifications, and conferences).
Are you ready to shape the future of Supply Chain Management with us? Apply now and tell us why you are the perfect candidate to lead the digital revolution.

data.advertised_job_title: Master's Thesis: Data-Based Identification and Analysis of Operator-Specific Energy Losses in Mobile Machines
data.job_description:
Job Description
In the course of decarbonization and the increasing demands on the sustainability of mobile machines (such as excavators and wheel loaders), the operating phase turns out to be a significant influence. The individual operator behavior has a significant influence on real energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions. The topic of the master's thesis combines physical relationships with modern data analysis: The aim is to investigate how efficient and inefficient operating patterns can be distinguished and how these differences can be identified from the CAN bus signals already present on the machine. The exact focus of the thesis (more conceptual-analytical
or data-oriented-algorithmic) can be adapted to your personal strengths, your course of study and your interests. 
During your master's thesis, you will dive deep into the energy and loss mechanisms of mobile machines and identify sources of loss that can be influenced by the operator. 
You will then analyze and prepare real, machine-internal data streams. 
You will develop conceptual criteria for performance evaluation and the separation of environmental and operator processes. 
Based on this, you will develop algorithms, for example rule-based or machine learning, to identify work cycles and causes of loss. 
Finally, you will evaluate the practicality of your methods and derive recommendations for future driver assistance systems or feedback functions. 

Qualifications
Education: 
Master's degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, electrical engineering, data science or comparable
Experience and know-how: 
Initial knowledge of hydraulics, drive technology and vehicle systems; Programming skills (e.g. in Python or MATLAB) are an advantage

data.advertised_job_title: Master Thesis: Modelling of Leaks in a Rough Contact under Consideration of Multiscale Topography (f/m/div.)
data.job_description:
Job Description
Leakage is one of the important technological challenges in mechanical systems and affects various fluids – from water and lubricants to pressurized H₂. In this thesis, our goal is to model the leakage caused by a rough contact of an elastomer against steel in a static, elastic state. The challenge is that roughness has a multiscale nature, ranging from microns to nanometers, and that leakage can occur at different scales. To this end, there are a number of methods and theories in the literature for calculating leakage. During your thesis, you will create an overview of the existing models and implement the most suitable model for industrial applications. You will then compare the model with the company's in-house contact mechanics tools, as well as with analytical multiscale equations from engineering applications. Finally, you will derive surrogate or metamodels to predict leakage based on simulation data using simplified equations. 

Qualifications
Education: 
Master's degree in Computational Engineering, Physics, Numerical Mathematics, Industrial Mathematics, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent, with very good grades
Experience and knowledge: 
in simulation and mathematical modeling; first experience with Python and/or MATLAB
Personality and way of working: 
You are characterized by working on tasks independently, in a structured and disciplined manner
Working Mode: 
Your on-site presence is required
Languages: 
Fluent English and good knowledge of German

Additional information
Start: by prior arrangement  
Duration: 6 months  

The prerequisite for this thesis is enrollment at a college/university. Please attach your curriculum vitae, your transcript of records, the examination regulations and, if applicable, a valid work and residence permit.

data.advertised_job_title: Master's Thesis: Agentic AI System for a Semiconductor Database (f/m/div.)
data.job_description:
Job Description
As part of your master's thesis, you will build an agent AI system within the Robert Bosch IT infrastructure. You will connect this system to the semiconductor database (DB) as well as its DB description and train the agent with it. In addition, you will investigate how effectively the agent can translate natural language intentions into deterministic database operations. You will also analyze the efficiency and accuracy of the autonomous reasoning loops of the agent system compared to traditional human-in-the-loop data science workflows. Last but not least, you will learn how the agent tests hypotheses against historical data by simulating interventions (e.g. in manufacturing processes) to make robust, data-based decisions. 

Qualifications
Education: 
Master's degree in computer science, mathematics, physics or a comparable qualification
Experience and knowledge: 
Knowledge of Python, Machine Learning, Agentic AI, SQL, Git, and MCP; experience in software development as well as databases
Personality and way of working: 
You work independently and are open to constructive feedback

Your on-site presence is required

data.job_description:
Job Description
Ready to change the IT world?
We are looking for tech-savvy master’s graduates with a drive to make a difference, who will shape Bosch's digital transformation with us in our Junior Managers Program. If you are passionate about data, think strategically, and are eager to build an outstanding leadership career, we want to hear from you.​
Over an intensive 12 to 24-month journey, you will rotate through the key areas of our digital organization in Germany and abroad. Your mission is to gain a deep understanding of our business and our digital strategy, while building profound expertise in networking and developing digital business models relative to global IT infrastructure, cloud technologies, and the deployment of customer-oriented platforms and software solutions. You will work on and lead high-impact projects, receive guidance from experienced executives, and gain hands-edge practical experience with the latest technologies that are already redefining our industry.​
What you will learn and develop with us:​
You will learn how the global IT strategy of a tech company is linked to business goals in order to enable data-driven decisions and new digital business models.​
You will actively co-create the cloud transformation roadmap by leading the migration of enterprise applications and evaluating innovative cloud services for our internal and external customers.​
You will work with the latest tech stacks and agile methodologies to design web services, microservice architectures, and data pipelines that form the backbone of our digital products. At the same time, you will collaborate with your personal executive-level mentor on your strategic development to prepare you specifically for your future role as a leader in the technology environment at Bosch.​
Your academic foundation:
You have graduated with an outstanding (full-time) Master's degree in (Business) Informatics, (technical) Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. Your focus lies on topics such as cloud technologies, web services, IoT, Big Data, AI, software, and/or data analytics. Perhaps you already bring an MBA, PhD, or initial work experience.

Qualifications
Your passion for digital worlds:
You are naturally curious and ready to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and contexts. Initial experience with digitalization projects is a major plus.
Your eye for the bigger picture:
You find it fascinating to understand how a global enterprise operates and are highly motivated to link digital initiatives with overall business goals.
Your understanding of human-centric leadership:
You live by the conviction that outstanding results only emerge by empowering people. Utilizing emotional intelligence and empathy, you foster an environment where technology unlocks human potential and contributes to the success of the entire team.
You think strategically and shape the future:
You recognize the big picture, derive a clear vision from it as a leader, and develop the roadmap that takes us there. You have already gathered valuable practical insights in the software or I(o)T environment—ideally in medium-sized companies or start-ups. Practical experience in applying one or more programming languages such as Java, C, Python, Matlab, or similar also sets you apart.
Your continuous development:
In our dynamic environment, you leverage your ability to learn quickly every day, continuously developing yourself—a growth mindset that we actively support and nurture.
Your language proficiency:
You communicate fluently in English (negotiation level) and possess good German language skills (B2 level) to navigate confidently within both our international and local environments.

Additional Information
Why you will love being part of our community
We are deeply invested in the growth of our team members. We have created an environment where you are supported, valued, and empowered to do your best work.
Mentoring & Sponsoring:
An executive-level mentor will accompany you on your journey, actively support your development, and open doors for your next career steps with us.
A culture of belonging:
From day one, you will become part of a global community of trainees from diverse backgrounds and locations. Build authentic connections beyond formal projects through virtual hangouts, local meetups, or our (global) trainee summits.
Flexible & hybrid working:
We trust you to manage your work in a way that fits your life, with a flexible start date and a permanent employment contract. We offer a hybrid model that combines office and remote collaboration.
Continuous learning:
Benefit from up to 6 rotations across different departments, including an international rotation, supported by a generous budget for your professional development (courses, certifications, and conferences).

data.job_description:
Job Description
As a part of your Master thesis, you will develop a physics-informed current controller for grid-tied inverter control.
You will evaluate the linear regulator and the predictive controller as reference points, as well as establish their boundaries.
In addition, you will research current AI-based implementations in the literature.
Furthermore, you will be responsible for developing a concept to improve the implementation of AI-based black boxes and mitigate their drawbacks in grid-tied inverter applications.
Last but not least, you will select an AI-based concept, which may include machine learning, recurrent neural networks or reinforcement learning. If necessary, you will model the system alongside the implemented controller.

data.advertised_job_title: Junior Managers Program (Trainee) - Start your Leadership Journey in Business Intelligence & Analytics
data.job_description:
Job Description
Ready to make a real impact with data?
We are looking for analytically strong and tech-savvy master’s graduates with a drive to make a difference, who will drive Bosch's data-driven transformation with us in our Junior Managers Program. If you burn for data analytics, machine learning, and strategic challenges and aspire to build a leadership career, we want to meet you.​
Over an intensive 12 to 24-month journey, you will rotate through predominantly commercial and IT-related departments in Germany and abroad. Your mission is to gain a deep understanding of our business and data-driven decision-making processes, while building expertise in data analytics, digitalization, and machine learning.​
You will analyze complex challenges, identify optimization potentials along our business processes, and collaborate with specialist departments to develop innovative, data-based, digital solutions. In doing so, you will work on strategically relevant topics such as market analyses, forecasting, and the development of data-driven business decisions.​
Your academic foundation:
You have graduated with an outstanding (full-time) Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, (Business) Informatics, or a related field. Your focus ideally lies on topics such as data analytics, data science, machine learning, or quantitative methods. Perhaps you already bring an MBA, PhD, or initial work experience.​

Qualifications
Your passion for data-driven topics:
You have a strong passion for data and analytical challenges. You are motivated to structure and analyze large volumes of data and derive concrete, actionable recommendations from them. Initial practical experience in data analytics, data science, or data mining is an advantage.​
Your eye for the bigger picture:
You find it exciting to understand how business models work and how data-based insights contribute to the optimization of processes and strategies. You are highly motivated to link analytical results with entrepreneurial goals.​
Your understanding of human-centric leadership:
You are convinced that sustainable success is created through human collaboration. With empathy, openness, and enthusiasm, you succeed in winning others over to data-driven solutions and driving change forward together.​
Your continuous development:
You bring a strong growth mindset and are ready to continuously develop yourself in a dynamic environment, learning new technologies and methodologies quickly.​
Your language proficiency:
You communicate very well in English and possess good German language skills to navigate confidently within both our international and local environments. International experience of at least three months rounds off your profile.

Additional Information
Why you will love being part of our community
We are deeply invested in the growth of our team members. We have created an environment where you are supported, valued, and empowered to do your best work.
Mentoring & Sponsoring:
An executive-level mentor will accompany you on your journey, actively support your development, and open doors for your next career steps with us.
A culture of belonging:
From day one, you will become part of a global community of trainees from diverse backgrounds and locations. Build authentic connections beyond formal projects through virtual hangouts, local meetups, or our (global) trainee summits.
Flexible & hybrid working:
We trust you to manage your work in a way that fits your life, with a flexible start date and a permanent employment contract. We offer a hybrid model that combines office and remote collaboration.
Continuous learning:
Benefit from up to 6 rotations across different departments, including an international rotation, supported by a generous budget for your professional development (courses, certifications, and conferences).
Are you ready to shape the future of Business Intelligence with us? Apply now and tell us why you are the perfect candidate to lead the digital revolution.
Do you have questions about the application process?
Claudia Mertens-Baaij (Human Resources)
Telephone: 0711 811 7200
Our application process for the Junior Managers Program includes multiple steps:
a Video Interview, Assessment Center and a Final Interview.

We are looking for an intern in the field of data science and machine learning with a strong interest in production technology topics and/or computer vision. data.advertised_job_title: Internship in the field of digital twin and task simulation for a humanoid robot (f/m/div.)
data.job_description:
Job Description
Digital twins – high-precision virtual images of physical systems – are crucial to accelerate modern robotics research, as they enable rapid and safe testing of complex algorithms. The goal of this project is to build a realistic simulation environment for our humanoid robot, thus creating a "digital twin" for advanced development. During your internship, your job will include importing the robot's 3D model into a simulator such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim or Gazebo, as well as configuring physics and sensing. You will be responsible for creating a virtual environment in which the robot can interact. In addition, you will implement a Robot Operating System (ROS) bridge so that the simulated robot can be controlled using the same software that runs on the real hardware. data.job_description:
Job Description
You will be part of an innovative research project in which data-driven methods meet state-of-the-art technology. Are you ready to turn your ideas into impact? Apply now and help shape future solutions. 
You will perform a comprehensive analysis of existing force modeling methods for rotational loops and explore state-of-the-art machine learning approaches for sequence-to-sequence regression on time series data, such as symbolic regression, convolutional neural networks, and Mamba. As part of the data analysis, you will analyze and prepare the provided time series data, including feature engineering to extract relevant physical parameters. Based on your research, you will implement and train various machine learning frameworks for force prediction. 
To evaluate the developed approaches, you will create and use a robust comparison matrix based on key performance indicators such as forecast accuracy (RMSE, MAE), computational effort and interpretability. Throughout the project, you will document, present and discuss your results and progress with the project team on a regular basis. 

Qualifications

Master's degree in mechanical engineering, data science, computer science, physics or comparable
Experience and knowledge:

data.advertised_job_title: PhD – Agentic AI to Accelerate ASIC Development (f/m/div.)
data.job_description:
Job Description
We are looking for a highly motivated and creative person (m/f/d) who is interested in a PhD position in the field of design, verification and testing of ASICs (Application Specific Integrated Circuits) for use in complex sensor systems. In this position, you will have the opportunity to develop agentic AI software solutions to significantly accelerate development cycles in various design domains (digital design and verification, mixed-signal verification and testing). 
Your tasks and activities will include: 
Research on current AI platforms and tools based on available commercial, open-source, in-house, and academic solutions
In-depth insight into our ASIC development process
Analysis and integration of multimodal source solutions that process a. XML register maps, VHDL code files and Python-based test descriptions and convert them into machine-readable formats (e.g. Markdown)
Address high-impact use cases along the entire ASIC development lifecycle in various development domains, including digital design & verification, ASIC testing, and analog mixed-signal verification. Examples include automated VHDL code generation, automated generation of test elements for wafer testing, coverage-driven regression testing and optimization, AMS testbench generation, and closed-loop evaluation and optimization of test cases
Architecture selection, implementation, and critical evaluation of scalable and portable AI concepts (e.g., "human-in-the-loop" vs. fully automated AI agents) that are best suited for the use cases being studied
Holistic integration of the developed solutions into our ASIC development process as well as the associated data management using modern version control tools (e.g. GIT)
Collaboration and active exchange of ideas with experts in ASIC development as well as with internal and external research partners and expert networks
Participation in innovative projects in international and interdisciplinary teams for the global market leader in the field of sensing solutions
Writing scientific publications as well as publishing and presenting research results at international conferences and in journals

Qualifications
Personality: 
You have a high degree of enthusiasm and creativity as well as a real willingness to work together in international and interdisciplinary teams. 
Method of operation: 
You are an effective team player with a focused, methodical and very independent way of working. 
Experience & Expertise: 
Basic experience in the use of AI tools, agent development and prompting is mandatory. 
Strong expertise in Python scripting, a general understanding of VHDL and Verilog, as well as programming and the efficient handling of various data formats are required. 
Basic understanding of ASIC design methodologies in digital development, analog/mixed-signal simulation and wafer testing. 
Familiarity with platform-specific advantages and disadvantages of AI platforms in order to use them for the identified use cases. 
Experience in software development is an advantage. 
Languages: 
Very good English skills are mandatory; advanced knowledge of German is an advantage. 
Education: 
A university degree (diploma/M.Sc.) in electrical engineering, computer science or a comparable field with excellent academic achievements is required. 
We offer you: 
We offer you an inspiring and challenging environment in which you can successfully complete your PhD as part of a 3-year program. You will work closely with an interdisciplinary team and have access to state-of-the-art technologies and resources. In addition, we offer you the opportunity to participate in national and international conferences to present your research results, as well as access to the global Bosch doctoral network, the academic environment and other events. 

Additional information
Diversity and inclusion are not trends for us, but are firmly anchored in our corporate culture. Therefore, we welcome all applications – regardless of gender, age, disability, religion, ethnic origin or sexual identity. The final allocation of the doctoral topic is the responsibility of the supervising university, which also serves as a central point of contact for your doctoral project. If you are interested in this exciting doctoral position and meet the requirements, we look forward to receiving your detailed application, including your transcript of records. 

Do you have any questions about the application process?

+49 7121 35-33717

data.advertised_job_title: Technical Sales Representative (f/m/div.) Building automation in the field
data.job_description:
Job Description
What you can expect from us
You can look forward to a responsible job with development prospects in the field of building automation - embedded in a professional environment with attractive framework conditions: 
30 days of vacation plus additional time off for special occasions
Attractive remuneration in accordance with the company collective agreement including special payments and success component
Company car with the option of private use – including the option of plug-in or electric drive
2-3 days of mobile working per week
Flexible and individual training opportunities for your professional and personal development
Attractive company pension scheme at Bosch
A wide range of additional regional offers such as EGYM Wellpass, e-bike leasing and exclusive discounts via Bosch Corporate Benefits
Thanks to our innovative solutions in building and room automation as well as in energy management, we make buildings intelligent and efficient. To strengthen our team, we are looking for you as a Technical Sales Representative (f/m/div.) Building automation in the field at the Neukirchen site: 
You will take over the support and advice of existing and new customers and build up a sustainable customer and planner network. 
Your area of responsibility includes the creation, presentation and follow-up of offers as well as the independent acquisition of new projects. 
In addition, you will process service specifications, tenders and service descriptions in accordance with applicable standards and guidelines. 
In addition, you will calculate and prepare offers based on technical documents such as circuit diagrams, control diagrams, GA function lists and CAD documentation. 
In addition, you will be responsible for the design of components of building automation systems and clarify technical requirements with customers and engineering offices. 
You will also be responsible for conducting contract negotiations as well as preparing opportunity and risk analyses and observing market and project developments. 
In addition, you will record systems on site and hand over projects to the project management in a structured manner. 
You will actively contribute to the achievement of sales targets and take responsibility for your own projects. 

Qualifications
Education: 
Completed training in the field of electrical engineering, automation technology or HVAC technology or a comparable technical qualification. 
Experience and know-how: 
Initial professional experience in the field of electrical engineering, automation technology or HVAC technology desirable. Experience in internal sales is an advantage. Confident handling of MS Office, ideally SAP. Experience in dealing with technical documents such as CAD plans, circuit diagrams, control diagrams and GA function lists. Knowledge of relevant standards and guidelines (e.g. B. VOB/B, BGB, DIN 16484, DIN 3814) as well as hydraulic basics is an advantage. 
Way of working & personality: 
Structured, independent and team-oriented way of working as well as strong communication skills and enjoyment of customer contact. 
Languages: 
Very good written and spoken German. 

Additional information
Diversity and inclusion are an integral part of our corporate culture. We welcome applications from all people – regardless of gender, age, disability, religion, ethnic origin or sexual identity. 
Do you have any questions about the application process? 
Katharina Egert (Human Resources)
Phone: +49 5246 962-293
We look forward to receiving your application!

You have graduated with an outstanding Master's degree or Diploma and have set relevant academic priorities. Perhaps you already bring an MBA, PhD, or initial work experience.

You burn for technical details and enjoy finding creative solutions to complex challenges. You have the courage to explore new paths and take calculated risks along the way.

You want to understand how commercial and technical areas interact within a global enterprise—and how you can create real entrepreneurial value with your ideas.

For you, leadership means continuously developing yourself and others. With courage, openness, tolerance, and mindfulness, you inspire your environment and win others over to your vision.

You want to grow—both professionally and personally. You are curious, learn quickly, and view challenges as opportunities for continuous development—a growth mindset we actively support and nurture.

You communicate fluently in English (negotiation level) and possess good German language skills. Additionally, you have already gained at least three months of international experience.

An executive-level mentor will accompany you on your journey, actively support your development, and open doors for your next career steps with us.

data.advertised_job_title: PhD – Lab-on-a-Chip Sample Preparation for Next-Generation Molecular Diagnostics (f/m/div.)
data.job_description:
Job Description
Join our innovative research team. We are looking for a motivated PhD student to develop a magnetic beads-based microfluidic sample preparation unit that enables next-generation molecular diagnostics (MDx) workflows. Next-generation molecular diagnostics require robust and automated methods to isolate low-concentration biological targets – such as pathogens, circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), and extracellular vesicles (EVs) – from complex samples. The goal of this PhD project is to develop a scalable, cartridge-compatible platform for the controlled handling of functionalized magnetic particles throughout the sample preparation process, including capture, washing, transfer, resuspension, and release. The central goal is to establish a reusable microfluidic actuation module that works seamlessly with single-use diagnostic cartridges. 
You will conduct a targeted literature review on the manipulation of magnetic particles and develop multiphysics models (e.g. COMSOL) to optimize particle trajectories and fluid interactions. In addition, you will design and develop a reusable, cartridge-compatible microfluidic handling module that automates the entire extraction process of target molecules (capture, washing, transfer and release). You will create functional prototypes and quantify system performance experimentally based on key metrics such as target molecular yield (recovery), process time and reproducibility. Last but not least, you will translate your physical understanding and modeling results into robust design rules for integration into single-use diagnostic cartridges and provide transferable models and prototypes for future product development. 

Qualifications
Education: 
You have an excellent master's degree in biomedical engineering, mechanical engineering, applied physics, microsystems engineering (MEMS) or a comparable course of study. 
Experience and knowledge: 
You have in-depth knowledge of microfluidics, fluid mechanics and multiphysics simulation (e.g. COMSOL). You have practical experience in the development, prototyping and testing of lab-on-a-chip systems. Ideally, you are familiar with handling magnetic particles, non-Newtonian liquids (e.g. blood) or sample preparation for molecular diagnostics (MDx). 
Personality and way of working: 
You will work independently, plan your tasks carefully, and bring a high level of commitment and a strong hands-on mentality. You will be able to communicate your research results clearly and bridge the gap between theoretical simulation and physical prototyping by taking responsibility for your work. 
Enthusiasm: 
You are enthusiastic about interdisciplinary scientific work at the interface of physics, engineering and biomedicine, approach complex tasks creatively and innovatively and successfully transfer them into practical applications. 
Languages: 
You have very good written and spoken German and English skills.

data.advertised_job_title: Final thesis: Load unit for the working hydraulics on the roller dynamometer
data.job_description:
Job Description
The RPS4x4 chassis dynamometer enables the reproducible simulation of driving cycles for construction, agricultural and municipal machinery. So far, the representation has been limited to pure driving operation, while the components of the working hydraulics and the PTO drive (PTO) have not been taken into account. For the future, an extension with a mechanical-hydraulic load unit is planned. This will make it possible to map complete and realistic work cycles, such as the Y-cycle of a wheel loader, directly on the test bench. 
As part of your thesis, you will drive the development of new concepts and make well-founded decisions in concept selection that pave the way for future products. 
You will precisely design the required components and create detailed specifications that serve as a reliable basis for further development. 
In addition, you will transfer the selected concept into a concrete design and be responsible for its construction until it is ready for implementation. 
For the control and control of the load, you will develop innovative concepts that ensure optimal performance and set new standards. 
Furthermore, you will comprehensively validate the developed control concepts through the use of state-of-the-art simulation tools. 
You document your work results carefully and comprehensibly. 

Qualifications
Education: 
Degree in mechatronics, mechanics, electrical engineering or comparable
Experience and know-how: 
Good knowledge of hydraulics, mechanics, electrics, control engineering and design
Personality and way of working: 
You are a motivated team player

Partially mobile working possible by appointment

Fluent in German and English

by arrangement

data.advertised_job_title: PhD – Development of a novel lab-on-a-chip component for the analysis and sorting of individual cells (f/m/div.)
data.job_description:
Job Description
As part of our research team, you will work on future-oriented solutions for the life sciences. We offer you a PhD position for the development of a novel dielectrophoretic (DEP) chip for the analysis and sorting of individual cells. 
Multi-omics analyses at the single-cell level provide crucial diagnostic insights into diseases. However, current automation technologies are often inefficient and costly. Your project aims to overcome these limitations by developing an image-based DEP chip that automates the compartmentalization, sample preparation, analysis, and sorting of individual cells. This technology is expected to enable gentle, high-throughput multi-omics analyses for different sample types. 
You will develop and evaluate innovative concepts for semiconductor-based dielectrophoretic (DEP) chips and establish robust electrical, microfluidic and thermal operating parameters. In addition, you will investigate the physical limits of chip miniaturization and examine feasible manufacturing paths that are compatible with Bosch's CMOS technology. You will design and manufacture a functional demonstrator using semiconductor-based manufacturing processes and integrate it into a microfluidic system. Finally, you will characterize the prototype and perform a proof of concept for all operating modes using a representative bioassay with live cells in physiological media. 

Qualifications
Education: 
You have an excellent master's degree in electrical engineering, microsystems engineering, biomedical engineering, physics or a comparable field. 
Experience and knowledge: 
You have in-depth knowledge of classical MEMS technology, microfluidics and biomedical engineering; You have expertise in microfluidic and electrical design of lab-on-chip systems; You have experience in modeling physical cell interactions on a microscale; You have knowledge of (optical) signal processing; Experience with cleanroom processes as well as knowledge of oncology is an advantage. 
Personality and way of working: 
You actively contribute your ideas and communicate your research results clearly and convincingly; Your curiosity motivates you to explore new approaches and you like to take on a practical, hands-on role; You work in a structured way to achieve your goals, develop creative solutions to complex challenges and conduct experiments independently. 
Languages: 
You have very good written and spoken German and English skills.

Ready to push the boundaries of what is known today? 
We are looking for visionary thought leaders with a doctorate and the unconditional will to invent Bosch's technological future in the Junior Managers Program. If you have a deep passion for basic research, think strategically, and want to shape the future as a leader in central research, we would like to hear from you.
On an intensive journey of up to 18 months, you will rotate through the key areas of our global research and development organization. Your mission: To be a driving force to identify and develop new technologies and business opportunities that will secure Bosch's long-term innovative strength and competitiveness.
You'll lead highly innovative projects from idea to prototype, mentored by leading researchers and top executives, and gain hands-on experience with technologies that will shape our world of tomorrow.
What you will learn and develop with us:
You will learn how strategic research in the field of AI, quantum computing or semiconductor technology works in a global technology group, from trend analysis to patent development and transfer to the business units.
As a thought leader, you will shape the foundations for Bosch's future core technologies, whether it's the next generation of AI systems or the development of novel cloud architectures.
You will work with top international researchers in our global research centers to solve the technological challenges of the future, as well as your personal mentor from top management, who will prepare you specifically for your role as a future leader at Bosch.

data.advertised_job_title: Internship in process development and monitoring in laser beam welding
data.job_description:
Job Description
Electromobility – especially in the field of battery technology – requires highly stable and quality-assured manufacturing processes. Our team develops innovative laser system technology and laser-based welding processes for industrial large-scale production in special machine construction. As part of a research project, we are developing novel laser beam welding processes for battery systems in electromobility in our laboratory. With the help of integrated process monitoring and evaluation methods, we systematically investigate these processes to ensure process stability, seam quality and industrial applicability. 
During your internship, you will familiarize yourself with laser system technology and laser material processing with the support of the interdisciplinary team. The planning, implementation and evaluation of experiments on laser beam welding in the laboratory will be part of your area of responsibility. 
You will analyze laser welding processes for copper and aluminum compounds using different laser and optical combinations. 
In addition, you will be involved in the development, integration and application of processes for process monitoring during laser beam welding, e.g. optical and sensor-based measurement methods. 
Your job will include the acquisition, evaluation and statistical analysis of process and sensor data to evaluate process stability, seam quality and error mechanisms. 
Furthermore, you will examine the weld samples metallographically, statistically evaluate the results and derive recommendations for robust welding processes in industrial series production. 
Last but not least, you will prepare the results in the form of reports and presentations for international project teams and support the construction, commissioning and optimization of highly innovative production plants and system modules. 

Qualifications
Education: 
Degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, electrical engineering, physics or comparable with good academic performance
Experience and know-how: 
Ideally, initial experience in the fields of laser technology, optics and/or special machine construction

you find it easy to grasp complex issues quickly; you always act in a solution-oriented manner and are communicative in the team

data.advertised_job_title: PhD – Generative Models for Closed-loop Synthesis
data.job_description:
Job Description
We are conducting cutting-edge research on advanced generative models aimed at enhancing data efficiency in Bosch systems. We are seeking a PhD student who is passionate about exploring innovative applications of generative models (such as diffusion and autoregressive models) to simulate real-world scenarios for AI training and validation.
The development of AI models is often an iterative process that requires increasingly large datasets to address long-tail cases that are not represented in existing data. However, collecting data from the real world can be time-consuming and expensive, hindering the automation of the data loop. The objective of this thesis is to create new methodologies that enable generative models to substitute for the real-world, facilitating closed-loop interactions. This may involve designing novel control mechanisms to efficiently sample the required data and respond to interactions.
As a member of our team, you will:
Develop novel deep generative models (e.g., diffusion models) as data sources to enhance the training and validation of downstream models.
Collaborate with experts in deep learning and computer vision at the Bosch Center for AI to brainstorm and develop new ideas.
Aim for publications in top-tier journals and conferences.

Qualifications
Education:
excellent degree in Computer Science, or related field with focus on Computer Vision and Deep Learning
Experience and Knowledge:
strong background in deep learning and computer vision, experience with deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.), strong programming skills, in particular Python, knowledge and experience in deep generative modeling as well as foundation models are a plus, experience with publication of peer-reviewed research papers is beneficial
Enthusiasm:
motivation to work in an interdisciplinary and international team

very good English skills and academic writing skills

data.job_description:
Job Description
The design and development of innovative safety contracts will be your central focus. You will establish formal runtime interfaces to ensure secure interaction between decision-making and control in autonomous systems. You will define precise assumptions, guarantees and adaptation rules for modular autonomy stacks to ensure system integrity across different levels of abstraction. In addition, you will use advanced methods of optimal control, sequential decision-making under uncertainty and reinforcement learning to develop robust and powerful solutions. With the help of machine learning, you will derive feasibility margins, uncertainties and the safety contracts themselves from real-world data. A key goal is to translate research results into concrete applications – especially in the field of vehicle motion control and autonomous driving – in order to safely close the gap between high-level decisions and physical reality. Last but not least, you will make a significant contribution to making learning-based autonomy modular from the ground up, ensuring safety by design and enabling verification at runtime. 

Qualifications
Education:

data.advertised_job_title: Master's thesis: AI-based sensorless control of electric drives (f/m/div.)
data.job_description:
Job Description
Electric drives are at the heart of modern mechatronics, and the industry is increasingly moving towards sensorless control to estimate rotor positions using software instead of physical sensors. This thesis investigates how artificial intelligence and neural networks can fundamentally advance traditional control architectures. The aim is to explore and design advanced neural network concepts that learn control and estimation tasks. By mapping system measurands to control states, this research is expected to pave the way for the next generation of intelligent, software-defined control of electric drives. 
During your thesis, you will gain a sound understanding of the physical models of electric drives (e.g., electric machines, inverters) as well as the simulation environment. You will analyze current approaches in the field of machine learning and neural networks applied to sensorless control of electric drives. In addition, you will develop novel AI-based control architectures and investigate both modular and end-to-end designs of neural networks. You will implement, test, and validate your control algorithms using high-precision simulation models of electric drives. Finally, you will document your methodology, analyze the results, and present your findings to the development team. 

Qualifications
Education: 
Master's degree in cybernetics, engineering, mathematics, computer science or equivalent, with good grades
Experience and knowledge: 
In-depth knowledge of control engineering and machine learning; experience with Python or MATLAB
Personality and way of working: 
You excel in the analysis of complex issues, structure your tasks systematically and achieve results with a very independent way of working

data.advertised_job_title: PhD – Neural 3D Scene Representations for the Vehicle Interior (f/m/div.)
data.job_description:
Job Description
At Bosch Research, we are driving the next generation of physical AI: intelligent systems that can perceive their environment in the real world, infer about it, and act robustly. As vehicles become increasingly shared, automated, and software-defined, understanding what is happening inside the vehicle becomes as important as understanding the road in front of the vehicle. The ability to detect occupant position, posture, and movement is becoming both a regulatory requirement and a key enabler for future safety and comfort functions. However, current perception systems largely treat the vehicle interior and the exterior environment as separate domains, limiting their ability to form a consistent three-dimensional understanding of the interior from the small number of cameras that can realistically be deployed in a vehicle. 
In this PhD project, you will investigate neural 3D scene representations, including neural radiance fields, gaussian splatting, and implicit occupancy models, and adapt them to the particular challenges of in-cabin perception. Unlike in outdoor environments, where a moving sensor observes a largely static scene, the vehicle interior presents the opposite scenario: the structure is fixed and known, while the occupants are the primary source of movement, exhibiting articulate, deformable, and continuously changing movement patterns. You use this asymmetry as an advantage by using the known interior geometry as integrated supervision and by incorporating modern 3D-conscious diffusion models as trained priors. Your research focuses on reliably reconstructing occupants from only one to three fixed camera perspectives. 
A central goal of the project is to create a unified representation of the vehicle interior and the exterior environment. This should enable future end-to-end ADAS systems to be trained and validated, while at the same time infering about passengers as well as the surrounding traffic situation. As part of Bosch Research, you will work at the forefront of AI innovation while contributing to real-world industrial applications. You will help develop a new capability that combines the understanding of interior and exterior scenes, and work closely with leading experts from academia and industry to translate these advances into future safety-critical products. Your work combines basic research in 3D computer vision and generative modeling with the practical goal of making vehicles safer for everyone on board. 

Qualifications
Education: 
Very good master's degree in computer science or a comparable field of study
Experience and knowledge: 
Experience in machine learning with PyTorch, ideally with vision-based models and Neural Scene Representation
Very good programming skills in Python as well as in-depth knowledge of computer vision and 3D geometry, including camera models, projective geometry and multi-view constraints
Familiarity with 3D scene representations (e.g., NeRF, Gaussian Splatting, Implicit Occupancy Networks) or depth and 3D estimation methods is highly desired
First points of contact with differentiable rendering or estimating articulate human poses are an advantage
Personality and way of working: 
You combine a proactive and highly motivated attitude with the ability to move confidently in complex technical environments

Good written and spoken English skills

data.advertised_job_title: Master's Thesis: Ambient Sensing for Digital Health Biomarkers (f/m/div.)
data.job_description:
Job Description
Passive-ambient smart home sensor technology offers a unique, privacy-preserving way to continuously monitor health and functional independence in senior living. By analyzing subtle patterns of everyday life (e.g., use of household appliances, room changes, door movements), we can derive digital biomarkers that serve as early indicators of cognitive, metabolic, or physical health deterioration. 
As part of our research team, you will delve into ambient sensing, analyze real-world in-home datasets, and support the development of innovative models for assessing behavioral health indicators. You will conduct a comprehensive literature review on ambient sensing for healthcare applications. In addition, you will prepare and analyze passive sensor data (activity, attendance, power consumption) from our multi-home study cohort. You will research, develop, establish, and validate mathematical scoring algorithms that condense meaningful insights from the data. 
In addition, you will investigate secondary behavioral biomarkers and develop concepts such as tracking kitchen appliances in the context of nutrition and patterns of mobility during sleep. You will also validate and demonstrate your algorithms in controlled environments, including a health-oriented tiny house. Finally, you will document research results and code, evaluate the results and prepare them for internal presentations and a possible scientific publication. 

Qualifications
Education: 
Master's degree in computer science, data science, medical technology, biomedical engineering, physics or comparable, with very good academic performance
Experience and knowledge: 
Very good knowledge of Python as well as common data science libraries (e.g. Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn); Sound understanding of time series analysis, statistical modelling or machine learning; Knowledge of smart home systems (e.g. Home Assistant) or the processing of sensor data is an advantage

data.advertised_job_title: Master Thesis Ambient Sensing for Digital Health Biomarkers
data.job_description:
Job Description
Passive-ambient smart home sensors offer a unique, privacy-preserving opportunity to continuously monitor health and functional independence in senior living. By analyzing subtle patterns in daily life (e.g., appliance use, room transitions, door movements), we can derive digital biomarkers to act as leading indicators for cognitive, metabolic, or physical health decline.
As part of our research team, you will dive into ambient sensing, analyze real-world in-home datasets, and help develop cutting-edge behavioral health scoring models.
You will perform a comprehensive literature review on ambient sension for health applications.
Furthermore, you will preprocess and analyze passive sensor data (activity, presence, power usage) collected from our multi-home study cohort.
You will research, establish, and validate mathematical scoring algorithms that condense meaningful insights from the data.
Additionally, you will investigate secondary behavioral biomarkers, exploring concepts like nutrition/appliance tracking and sleep/mobility patterns.
Moreover, you will validate and showcase your algorithms in controlled environments, including inside a health-centric tiny home.
Finally, you will document research findings, code, and evaluate results for internal presentations and potential scientific publication.

Job Description
At Bosch Research, we are driving the next generation of physical AI – intelligent systems that can perceive the real world, reason, and act robustly. From automated driving to robotics, our goal is to develop AI technologies that are not only powerful, but also safe, efficient, and scalable. Despite remarkable advances in foundation models and end-to-end learning, today's autonomous systems continue to struggle to reliably generalize to new situations, and often require enormous amounts of data as well as significant computing resources. For Bosch products, however, AI solutions must also perform strongly in real-world conditions – such as limited computing power, high energy efficiency, safety, and reliability. 
In this PhD project, you will explore new approaches to develop the next generation of efficient autonomous decision-making systems. Your research combines ideas from imitation learning, reinforcement learning, large-scale simulation, world models, and model compression to develop AI agents (across multiple forms) that continuously improve, adapt to novel situations, and effectively master the transfer from simulation to reality. A central focus of the project is to enable resource-efficient physical AI: they achieve the reliability and generalization capability of today's leading AI systems while significantly reducing the computational requirements required for use on real devices.
