As a specialist in Power Management, you develop innovative concepts and circuits for Power Management ICs (PMICs) and System Basis Chips (SBCs).
In close cooperation with internal and external partners, you develop new functions for ASIC circuit blocks, alongside novel circuit concepts and methodologies.
Last but not least, you harmonize solutions and procedures within the project team and with customers or system architects, while actively mentoring junior engineers.

Qualifications
Education:
completed university studies in Electrical Engineering or a comparable field, ideally with a focus on microelectronics or semiconductor development
Experience and Knowledge:
several years of professional experience in analog/mixed-signal IC development; expertise in power management with a focus on the design of DC/DC converters, buck/boost regulators, LDOs, gate drivers and Current Sense Amplifiers (CSAs); in-depth application know-how in Automotive Smart Power (e.g., System-IC, PMIC); proficiency with industry-standard EDA tools, particularly within the Cadence Virtuoso environment; experience with hardware description languages like Verilog-A
Personality and Working Practice:
you take ownership for overall success, setting clear priorities and effectively utilizing resources; you prioritize common goals over individual interests, positively influencing your work environment; you recognize and foster individual strengths within your team; you embrace challenges as opportunities for further development, shaping sustainable learning processes
Languages:
very good English communication skills, both written and spoken; German language skills are a plus

This role is designed for a professional who has mastered the fundamentals of US and Canadian indirect tax compliance and is ready to take ownership of complex projects, including tax technology initiatives and indirect tax compliance, research and governance. The outgoing, collaborative and initiative-taking candidate will be responsible for tax controls and ensuring efficient operations for Bosch entities by improving processes, data analysis and technology. Position will work closely with Tax, Accounting, Purchasing, Sales, IT, Business Units, Tax Jurisdictions and External Providers.
Key Responsibilities
Responsible for timely completion of indirect tax (US state and local sales, use tax and gross receipts tax; Canadian GST; VAT; Property Tax, Unclaimed Property) compliance and reporting.
Lead sales & use tax nexus determination, registrations and renewals.
Responsible for indirect tax payments, notices, and correspondences.
Prepare Form W-9 and annual federal Form 1099 reporting.
Processing and management of sales tax exemption certificate system.
Lead process improvement initiatives to standardize and automate indirect tax area.
Assist with implementing policy and procedures in the indirect tax area.
Assist with tax technology implementations.
Assist with indirect tax audits.
Provide support and assistance in all aspects of tax compliance functions to include technical research and analysis.
Ability to interact professionally with business units and other staff members.

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or related field.
3+ years in a corporate environment; national/regional accounting or indirect tax firm

2+ years proficiency with indirect tax systems (Vertex); ERP (SAP); and Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., advanced Excel functions: pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, data modeling).
1+ years proficiency with data analytic; desktop automation, data visualization and AI tools.

CPA or CPA candidate

Canadian indirect tax and VAT experience

Strong project management and organizational skills. Ability to prioritize and concurrently manage multiple responsibilities.

Experience in a manufacturing environment.

Work from either the office or home using company systems as directed by your supervisor.

Technical knowledge of system piping, hydronics, wiring, water source heat pump controls, heat exchange fluid transfer, air conditioning circuits, compressors.
Excellent problem-solving skills, initiative, and a strong customer-oriented approach.
Exceptional communication and phone skills with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

Job Description
The
Engineering Trainer - Commercial HVAC Applications
will be a key member of the Bosch Home Comfort Factory Training team, reporting directly to the Sales Technology and Training Innovation Lead. This role is central to our mission of driving the specification of Bosch technologies by empowering the engineering and design community. The position champions a design-focused training philosophy, educating specifying engineers, design-build contractors, and bid-spec representatives on the superior application and performance of our commercial HVAC portfolio.
As a technical authority, the Application Trainer is pivotal in supporting the market integration of our newly expanded commercial product lines. The role involves creating and delivering sophisticated, application-focused training that positions Bosch, FHP, and Hitachi systems as the preferred solution in competitive bids and project specifications. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in the system design, application, and specification of light commercial rooftops, commercial Water Source Heat Pump (WSHP) systems, and 3-phase Variable Refrigerant Flow (VRF) systems. This mid-level salaried position involves up to 30% travel across the United States and Canada and requires a blend of engineering acumen, polished presentation skills, and a passion for influencing the future of building design.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and deliver high-level technical presentations, seminars, and workshops for engineering firms, specifying engineers, and other design professionals.
Create and maintain a library of technical sales and design tools, including application guides, system selection software tutorials, BIM object libraries, and master specification documents.
Translate complex product features into compelling performance and application benefits relevant to the design and specification process.
Deliver specialized training on our expanded portfolio, including our light commercial RTUs, Hitachi VRF, and Bosch WSHP systems, as well as key industry trends like electrification, decarbonization, and the transition to low-GWP refrigerants.
Serve as a go-to technical authority for the application and design of Bosch's commercial HVAC systems, providing expert guidance to internal teams and external partners.
Provide direct support to the specification community, assisting with system design, energy modeling, and the development of project-specific specifications that favor Bosch solutions.
Collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, and Quality teams to stay current on new products, system updates, and evolving building codes and energy standards (e.g., ASHRAE 90.1).
Act as a key technical partner to our manufacturer's representatives and distribution partners, equipping them with the knowledge to effectively call on and support engineering firms.
Develop content for and participate in industry events, trade shows, and professional organizations (e.g., ASHRAE, AIA) to promote Bosch's technical leadership.
Gather and analyze feedback from the engineering community to inform product development, competitive positioning, and future training strategies.

Qualifications
Minimum of 3-5 years of relevant experience in the HVAC industry, with a strong background in commercial system design and application.
Demonstrated experience working with or for engineering firms, with a deep understanding of the bid-spec process.
Expertise in the system design and specification of some or all of the following systems:
Light commercial rooftop units.
Commercial Water Source Heat Pump (WSHP) systems, including geothermal and cooling tower/boiler applications.
3-phase Variable Refrigerant Flow (VRF) systems, including heat recovery models.
Proven experience in a technical training, application engineering, or specification-focused sales role.
Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to confidently convey complex technical information to engineering professionals.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Valid driver's license and the ability to travel up to 30% within the US and Canada.
Preferred Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering Technology, or a related technical discipline.
Bilingual proficiency in English and French is a significant asset, given the need to provide training and support in French-speaking regions of Canada.
Experience with Commercial Water Source Heat Pump (WSHP) systems, including geothermal and cooling tower/boiler applications.
Experience with HVAC design, load calculation, or energy modeling software (e.g., Trane TRACE™, Carrier® HAP, IESVE).
Professional Engineer (P.E.) license or LEED AP certification.
Deep knowledge of inverter/variable speed heat pump technology and advanced HVAC controls.
Active membership in industry organizations such as ASHRAE.
EPA 608 Universal Certification.
Additional Information
Travel: Up to 30% within the US and Canada.

Additional Information
Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only.  Future sponsorship for work authorization unavailable.
Additional Information
In addition to your base salary, Bosch offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision plans; health savings accounts (HSA); flexible spending accounts; 401(K) retirement plan with an attractive employer match; wellness programs; life insurance; long term disability insurance; paid time off; parental leave. Pay ranges included in the postings, when included, generally reflect base salary; certain positions may include bonus, or additional benefits.
Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans
*Bosch adheres to Federal, State, and Local laws regarding drug-testing. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screen and background check. Candidates who have been offered the position must pass both screenings before their start date.

Job Description
The Payroll Tax Analyst is responsible for ensuring payroll tax compliance and reconciliations in the United States. You will play a vital role in delivering accurate statutory reporting, timely remittance submissions, and resolving payroll tax issues, while also supporting payroll processing as needed. You will have hands on exposure to payroll operations, collaboration with internal stakeholders, and participation in audits and compliance initiatives.
Job Responsibilities:
Prepare, reconcile, and file monthly, quarterly, and annual payroll tax returns for U.S. federal, state, and local agencies
Reconcile W-2 forms and prepare any necessary adjustments for W-2c corrections
Resolve complex employee tax questions and issues and ensure the education of the HR services team to triage and respond to simpler questions and issues
Research and respond to monthly variances related to payroll and tax accounts
Reconcile quarterly and annual payroll tax reports for federal agencies, states, and other local entities
Ensure that annual tax statements and adjustments are posted timely and accurately for employees, including those on international assignments
Research and respond to federal, state, and local tax notices, and support and manage the response for tax audits and jurisdictional inquiries
Research required payroll taxes for federal agencies, states, provinces, and local entities and ensure these jurisdictions are updated on time in our on-premise payroll system for proper employee and company withholding
Provide specialist support for mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures as required

Qualifications
Required Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance or taxation, or HS Diploma.
2+ years of experience with multi-state, and local payroll tax experience.  Strong knowledge of US payroll tax regulations and compliance requirements
.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, forecasting, and reconciliation
Proficiency in auditing techniques and advanced payroll compliance knowledge
Experience with multi-state full cycle payroll processing, including tax withholding and general ledger entry
Demonstrated understanding of payroll including garnishments, bonus payments, special payments, and payroll taxes for the US
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a keen attention to detail
Experience identifying, evaluating, and supporting process improvements
Intermediate to Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, formulas, VLOOKUPs, charts, and graphs
Highly organized with exceptional time management, capable of handling multiple deadlines and priorities in a fast-paced environment

Partners including TRATON GROUP’s Scania, MAN, and International brands, Hyundai Motor Company, Iveco Group, Bosch, and DSV are working with Plus to accelerate the deployment of next-generation autonomous trucks. PlusAI is a Physical AI company pioneering AI-based virtual driver software for factory-built autonomous trucks. Headquartered in Silicon Valley with operations in the United States and Europe, Plus was named by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Partners including TRATON GROUP’s Scania, MAN, and International brands, Hyundai Motor Company, Iveco Group, Bosch, and DSV are working with Plus to accelerate the deployment of next-generation autonomous trucks. If you’re ready to make a huge impact and drive the future of autonomy, Plus is looking for talented individuals to join its fast-growing teams.


About the Team
The Planning team is responsible for making sure PlusAI’s trucks make the right decision in every driving situation, safely, smoothly, and predictably for other road users, even when working with noisy, uncertain, or incomplete information about the world. This is a cross-functional problem that requires close collaboration with Perception, Prediction, Controls, and Safety, and a willingness to work at the edge of research and production: bringing state-of-the-art decision-making and optimization techniques into a system that runs on real trucks, on real roads, today.

About the Role
As a Senior Software Engineer on the Motion Planning team, you’ll research, develop, and implement planning technologies that let PlusAI’s trucks handle complex, real-world driving scenarios in a safe and human-like manner. You’ll work across the full decision-making stack, from reasoning about what the truck should do to determining precisely how it should get there, while accounting for the many ways a scenario could unfold.

About the Team

This is a cross-functional problem that requires close collaboration with Perception, Prediction, Controls, and Safety, and a willingness to work at the edge of research and production: bringing state-of-the-art decision-making and optimization techniques into a system that runs on real trucks, on real roads, today.

About the Role
As a Senior Software Engineer on the Motion Planning team, you’ll research, develop, and implement planning technologies that let PlusAI’s trucks handle complex, real-world driving scenarios in a safe and human-like manner. You’ll work across the full decision-making stack, from reasoning about what the truck should do to determining precisely how it should get there, while accounting for the many ways a scenario could unfold.

Responsibilities
Design and implement algorithms for decision-making and trajectory generation, ensuring safety, comfort, and reliability across a wide range of driving conditions.
Bring novel robotics and machine learning techniques from research into a production-grade, safety-critical system.
Reason about complex, socially-nuanced driving situations, such as negotiating merges, junctions, and interactions with other road users, under uncertainty.
Utilize modern C++ numerical optimization frameworks (e.g., CasADi, Acados) and industry-standard tooling (git, ROS, etc.) to integrate new planning algorithms into the production stack.
Partner closely with the ML and prediction teams to integrate, refine, and act on probabilistic and multi-future representations of how a scenario might evolve, shaping how these outputs are consumed by planning decisions.
Perform system-level diagnostics and tuning using in-house and open-source visualization tools (e.g., webviz).
Collaborate cross-functionally and communicate clearly, producing system designs that are reviewed and approved at a high level before implementation begins.

Required skills
MS with 1-2 years of relevant experience, or PhD, in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field.
Strong production software development skills in C++; Python experience a plus.
Robotics expertise in one or more of: path planning, motion planning, trajectory generation, behavior planning, optimal control.
Strong math (geometry, analysis, probability) and physics (kinematics, dynamics) fundamentals.
Experience designing, implementing, and refining planning algorithms on a real-world robotic or vehicle platform.
Strong oral and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and derive solutions from cross-functional input

Preferred skills
PhD + 1-2 years or MS + 3-4 years of relevant experience.
Bonus: exposure to machine learning techniques such as deep learning, imitation learning, transformer-based models, or diffusion-based models, particularly as applied to decision-making or scenario generation.
Familiarity with safety frameworks for autonomy (e.g., RSS, collision avoidance/MRM logic).
Prior experience working on safety-critical systems.

Your opportunities joining PlusAI
Work, learn and grow in a highly future-oriented, innovative and dynamic field.
Wide range of opportunities for personal and professional development.
Catered free lunch, unlimited snacks and beverages.
Highly competitive salary and benefits package, including 401(k) plan.

About us
Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology.  Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.
Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward.  Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.
In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.
At Wayve, your contributions matter.  We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.
Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!
The role
As a Technical Program Manager at Wayve, you'll lead complex, cross-functional programs across our engineering org - spanning AI, software, robotics, vehicle hardware and platforms, infrastructure, simulation, evaluation, validation, data, and product. You'll turn ambiguity into clear plans and keep multi-team delivery predictable in a fast-moving environment.
Working closely with engineering and cross-functional partners, your impact will be measured by your ability to deliver programs, drive efficiency, manage risk, and align execution with business goals. A successful TPM is a force multiplier - helping teams move faster, more effectively, and with purpose.
We hire TPMs across several areas - for example AV engineering (robotics, perception, parking, ADAS), vehicle platforms (hardware, vehicle software, architecture), simulation, evaluation & validation, robotaxi, AI infrastructure, and data - and we'll explore the best fit with you through the process.
Key Responsibilities
Drive project delivery:
Own the project lifecycle and improve delivery outcomes through structured execution and coordination.
Boost efficiency:
Identify bottlenecks, streamline workflows, and improve tooling and resource allocation to increase throughput.
Enable cross-team collaboration:
Improve alignment across teams through effective communication, shared goals, and faster decisions.
Manage risk proactively:
Anticipate issues, develop mitigation plans, and minimise impact on timelines and quality.
Keep stakeholders aligned:
Engage regularly with internal stakeholders, manage expectations, and deliver on commitments.
Align with business goals:
Ensure programs directly support Wayve's strategic priorities by making smart scope and resource decisions.
Champion continuous improvement:
Lead retros, encourage feedback, and implement changes to improve processes, team dynamics, and outcomes.
About you
We're looking for the following skills and experience.
Essential
Bias for action / program delivery:
5+ years leading complex, multi-team software or technology programs in fast-paced or early-stage environments. You get things done.
Technically strong:
Comfortable working with engineers and reasoning about modern software, ML, and robotics stacks, even if you don't write code.
Systems thinking:
You reason about how the parts of a complex system fit together, and how a change in one area ripples into others.
Stays neutral and adapts under pressure:
Effective in high-tension, ambiguous situations; you flex your style to keep people aligned and moving.
Strong project management:
Skilled at planning, prioritising, managing risk and dependencies, and adapting as things change.
Clear communicator:
You explain complex ideas simply, surface risk early, listen well, and keep teams aligned.
Collaborative leader:
You bring people together, influence without authority, and create a positive team culture.
Strategic thinking & problem-solving:
You keep the bigger picture in mind, stay calm under pressure, and find creative solutions.
Product-minded:
You focus on outcomes and the people your programs serve - prioritising by impact and defining what good looks like, not just tracking activity.
Growth mindset:
Open to feedback and always looking to improve.
Desirable
Ideally 8+ years as a Technical Program Manager.
An engineering or computer science degree, or experience working as an engineer; excels in Jira (or similar).
Exposure to autonomous vehicles, robotics, perception, vehicle hardware / embedded, ML, simulation / evaluation, or other safety-critical or compute-heavy domains.
This is a full-time role based in our Tel Aviv office. At Wayve we want the best of all worlds, so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, with time spent working from home.

The role
At Wayve, we are building AI that learns to drive from experience.
We do not hand-code cars to drive. We train our models from data gathered across the real world, making our ability to identify, understand and learn from the right data fundamental to everything we build.
We are looking for a
VP of Data
to lead the data strategy behind our autonomous driving technology.
This is a senior engineering leadership role with end-to-end ownership of how Wayve uses data to improve our AI. You will determine what data we need, how we acquire it, how we understand and enrich it, and ultimately how we turn it into measurable improvements in model performance.
The scale and shape of the problem is unique. Our data comes from our own vehicles, OEM programmes, partners and external sources, spanning different vehicles, sensors, markets and driving environments. Within that corpus, the most valuable examples are often the hardest to find: rare behaviours, unusual interactions, safety-critical events and the long tail of real-world driving.
Your job is not simply to build the systems that process this data. It is to decide
what data matters and why
, and build the strategy, organisation and learning loop that allows Wayve to learn from it faster.
You will lead Wayve’s Data organisation and provide senior ownership for data within Engineering, partnering closely across AI, Science, Validation, Product, Compute and our commercial teams.
Key Responsibilities
Own Wayve’s data strategy:
Set the strategy across the complete AI learning cycle, determining what data we need and how it should drive model performance, from foundation model training through specialised driving capabilities and production programmes.
Build the data flywheel:
Own the learning loop from real-world signals and model behaviour through data discovery, curation and enrichment into training, evaluation, deployment and measurement.
Find the data that matters:
Develop intelligent approaches to discovering rare, surprising and safety-critical scenarios within extremely large datasets, using techniques such as embeddings, semantic search, learned representations and model-driven data selection.
Lead data acquisition and enrichment:
Define how Wayve collects, buys, generates and enriches data across our own fleet, OEM programmes, partners and external sources, balancing coverage, quality, speed and economics.
Connect data investment to model performance:
Establish how we measure the value of data and make rigorous trade-offs across quality, accuracy, speed, cost and scale, ensuring investment is focused where it creates the greatest impact.
Scale our data strategy globally:
Build an approach that supports multiple OEMs, vehicle platforms, sensor configurations, geographies and regulatory environments while maintaining a scalable global architecture.
Build and lead the organisation:
Lead and develop a high-performing, multidisciplinary Data organisation, partnering closely with AI, Science, Validation, Product, Compute, Finance and Commercial teams.
About You
You are a senior technical leader who has operated at the intersection of
AI, data and large-scale model development
.
You can set direction in ambiguity and make high-quality decisions without perfect information. You are equally comfortable going deep into the characteristics and value of a dataset, challenging how a team measures model improvement, making significant investment decisions, or defining how an organisation should operate.
You have strong technical judgement, but think about data through the impact it has on the intelligence and performance of the system, rather than simply the infrastructure required to store and process it.
You can hold the full system in your head while still going deep on the details that matter.
Essential
Significant engineering leadership experience, with a track record of building and leading high-performing technical organisations.
Deep technical expertise in
computer vision, video, multimodal AI or related perception problems
.
Experience leading large-scale data capabilities that directly influence
model training, evaluation and performance
.
Strong intuition for
what makes data valuable
, with experience in data discovery, selection, curation and enrichment at scale.
Strong technical and commercial judgement, including making trade-offs across
quality, speed, cost, scale and build-versus-partner decisions
.
Ability to move between strategy and technical detail, set direction in ambiguity, and influence effectively across senior technical and business stakeholders.
Desirable
Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a strong advantage:
Autonomous driving, robotics or embodied AI.
Large-scale video, multimodal or foundation model training.
Semantic search, embeddings, active learning, auto-labelling or other approaches to intelligent data selection and enrichment.
Large-scale real-world data acquisition across fleets, customers, partners or multiple geographies.

Directional segmentation

The platform engineering is further divided into two directions, with candidates focusing on one: 
- Embodied Direction: Focuses on embodied large models, such as VLA and world models, for platform training, evaluation, inference, and data closed-loop construction. 
- Algorithm Direction: Focuses on algorithm engineering beyond embodiment, including model development pipelines and platform capabilities for tasks such as CV and deep learning.

1. Full product lifecycle commercialization (NPI/NPP/GTM full-process management)

Coordinate the introduction of new NPI in-vehicle intelligent driving computing chips, NPP mass production ramp-up, and full-cycle marketization work for GTM launch and implementation; Based on development trends in the vehicle intelligent driving industry, needs of leading automakers, and competitor dynamics, deliver product market strategies, pricing systems, and launch implementation plans, coordinate the commercial closed-loop management from R&D initiation to batch vehicle rollout, and control product mass production introduction and market implementation pace.

Built a standardized sales empowerment system, providing professional training, solution presentations, and technical empowerment for domestic sales teams and channel partners on intelligent driving chip + supporting toolchain products; Led and coordinated targeted promotion meetings, industry technology summits, and special client matchmaking meetings for leading automakers, deeply exploring opportunities for mass production projects at OEMs, and empowering frontline teams to efficiently complete Design-In implementation. 

3. Cross-platform core docking hub

Serves as the official external liaison window for the group's platform chip product line, coordinating with multiple departments including chip R&D, supply chain planning, project management, quality, and automotive business divisions, connecting internal information flow chains, synchronizing key information such as product specification iterations, capacity planning, quality control, and delivery rhythm, and coordinating solutions to bottlenecks throughout the project implementation chain. 

4. Plenipotentiary market representative of the PDT project team

As the fixed market representative of the PDT product development team for intelligent driving chips, he is deeply involved in the entire process of chip front-end specification definition, architecture review, and sample verification. From the perspective of market implementation and automakers' mass production needs, he delivers product optimization suggestions, anchors the commercialization feasibility of product implementation, ensures R&D outputs meet the demands of end-user vehicle mass production, and efficiently advances the implementation of the full-category intelligent driving chip Design-In project. 

5. Expansion of the L4 advanced intelligent driving + all-scenario chip & toolchain market

Focusing on core tracks such as advanced autonomous driving L4 domain control, integrated driving and parking, and cabin-driving integration, with chip + supporting toolchain integrated solutions as the core lever, it is expanding into multi-domain in-vehicle customer markets including passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and Robotaxi; It gains insights into new technologies and application trends in the domain control chip industry, lays out cutting-edge product routes, builds the company's market moat for intelligent driving chip products, and expands ecosystem cooperation resources. 

6. Refined operation of product line lifecycles

Coordinate lifecycle management for all in-vehicle intelligent driving chips, covering part number (PN) control, yield tracking, and automotive-grade quality (Zero Defect) full-chain control; Coordinate supply chain and production planning to optimize stocking, inventory, and production launch strategies, coordinate iteration of old products, final order EOL delisting, and last buy stocking planning, balancing product profitability with supply chain stability. 

Requirements
1. Market Operation Capability

Proficient in standardized methodologies for full-chain marketing of in-vehicle chips, possesses complete practical experience in NPI-NPP-GTM commercialization, can independently build a market operation system for intelligent driving chip products, and has successful mass production and targeted implementation cases of leading automakers. 

2. Specialized hardware technology background

Deeply cultivating foundational knowledge of automotive computing chips, proficient in core technical principles such as SoC computing units, IO architecture, data flow scheduling, and domain controller hardware architecture, capable of independently dismantling customer vehicle solution requirements and delivering chip adaptation implementation technical solutions. 

3. Professional foundation in automotive specification systems

Familiar with automotive-grade standards such as AEC-Q100 and ISO26262, proficient in key automotive compliance requirements including Zero Defect quality management system for automotive chips and EMC/EMI electromagnetic compatibility, and deeply understanding the quality control logic of automotive-grade chips from prototype to mass production. 

4. Product lifecycle management capability

Proficient in the entire lifecycle management logic of semiconductor chips, proficient in controlling the PN part number system, wafer/packaging/testing yield, mass production quality, inventory, and delisting at all nodes, enabling collaboration between supply chain and production planning to optimize production-sales matching. 

5. Industry resources and project management

Possesses leading OEMs of L2+/L4 intelligent driving domain controller chips, high-quality Tier 1 client resources, excellent cross-departmental coordination, business negotiation, and project advancement capabilities, and team management experience leading teams to expand the implementation of chip + toolchain integrated solutions.

data.job_description:
Introduction to the high-precision maps and positioning team
If we compare autonomous vehicles to the human brain, high-precision maps and positioning systems roughly correspond to the parts of the latter responsible for spatial memory, perception, and positioning. Their mission is to provide detailed and accurate road 3D geometry and semantic information for autonomous vehicles, enabling them to fully understand their driving environment and move freely. We are also responsible for delivering high-speed, accurate 3D positioning, so vehicles know their exact current position at all times. High-precision maps and positioning occupy a very important position in the autonomous vehicle technology stack. Major modules such as perception, planning, control, and simulation rely on the road environment and vehicle location information they provide to understand the surrounding world and make correct decisions. WeRide's high-precision maps and positioning team has grown together with the company, fully independently building large-scale high-precision maps covering over 3,000 kilometers of roads across multiple cities in China and the US, providing centimeter-level 3D structural data as well as a wealth of semantic information such as lane lines and traffic signals. Its independently developed positioning technology, based on the fusion of LiDAR, cameras, satellites, and inertial navigation, can provide real-time centimeter-level positioning, successfully enabling autonomous driving across a 1.5-kilometer-long tunnel during heavy rain. 
In AI applications, high-precision maps and positioning are quite unique. We know that computer vision, as an important branch of AI, has core problems divided into semantic understanding and geometric understanding. The former aims to parse the semantic information of objects or scenes in images, while the latter aims to reconstruct 3D scenes and perform 3D positioning of objects. In high-precision maps and positioning systems, both of these major technologies have very critical applications. In addition, we are heavy users of hardware such as high-precision satellites and inertial navigation, and multimodal signal processing and fusion are among our core technologies. Therefore, this is a highly interdisciplinary application. Whether you are proficient in deep learning and other machine learning techniques, specializing in 3D reconstruction and SLAM, or expert in signal processing and multi-sensor fusion, there is broad room for you to shine. At the same time, we are committed to building large-scale, highly usable high-precision map systems, where big data and full-stack programming experts can also find their applications.

Introduction to the high-precision maps and positioning team
If we compare autonomous vehicles to the human brain, high-precision maps and positioning systems roughly correspond to the parts of the latter responsible for spatial memory, perception, and positioning. Their mission is to provide detailed and accurate road 3D geometry and semantic information for autonomous vehicles, enabling them to fully understand their driving environment and move freely. We are also responsible for delivering high-speed, accurate 3D positioning, so vehicles know their exact current position at all times. High-precision maps and positioning occupy a very important position in the autonomous vehicle technology stack. Major modules such as perception, planning, control, and simulation rely on the road environment and vehicle location information they provide to understand the surrounding world and make correct decisions. WeRide's high-precision maps and positioning team has grown together with the company, fully independently building large-scale high-precision maps covering over 3,000 kilometers of roads across multiple cities in China and the US, providing centimeter-level 3D structural data as well as a wealth of semantic information such as lane lines and traffic signals. Its independently developed positioning technology, based on the fusion of LiDAR, cameras, satellites, and inertial navigation, can provide real-time centimeter-level positioning, successfully enabling autonomous driving across a 1.5-kilometer-long tunnel during heavy rain. 
In AI applications, high-precision maps and positioning are quite unique. We know that computer vision, as an important branch of AI, has core problems divided into semantic understanding and geometric understanding. The former aims to parse the semantic information of objects or scenes in images, while the latter aims to reconstruct 3D scenes and perform 3D positioning of objects. In high-precision maps and positioning systems, both of these major technologies have very critical applications. In addition, we are heavy users of hardware such as high-precision satellites and inertial navigation, and multimodal signal processing and fusion are among our core technologies. Therefore, this is a highly interdisciplinary application. Whether you are proficient in deep learning and other machine learning techniques, specializing in 3D reconstruction and SLAM, or expert in signal processing and multi-sensor fusion, there is broad room for you to shine. At the same time, we are committed to building large-scale, highly usable high-precision map systems, where big data and full-stack programming experts can also find their applications.

• Responsible for developing multi-sensor fusion mapping algorithms based on GNSS, Lidar, camera, and other technologies
• Responsible for developing real-time construction algorithms for local high-precision maps and relocation/loop algorithms
• Responsible for developing automatic map element recognition and intelligent annotation tools

• Practical, diligent, proactive, eager to learn, and possess team spirit
• Clear logic and strong communication and expression skills
• Preference given to those who have published papers in high-level conferences or well-known journals
• Candidates with backgrounds in autonomous driving, robotics, or drones are preferred
Preference will be given to candidates with at least one of the following backgrounds or experience, and multiple matching qualifications: 
• Use of VLM/SAM during the mapping process
• Familiar with at least two of the following mainstream SLAM frameworks: ORB-SLAM series, LIO-SAM, LOAM series, Cartographer, VINS
• Familiar with SLAM-related software or codebases: at least one such as ROS, Eigen, Ceres, g2o, GTSAM, etc
• Machine learning algorithm theory and practice, including deep learning (familiar with mainstream frameworks such as TensorFlow, Torch, MXNet, etc.), and classic machine learning algorithms (GBDT, SVM, etc.). Introduction to the PNC Group: 
In autonomous driving systems, decision-making, planning, and control can be likened to the human brain and nerves. Ensuring that the "brain and nerves" "think" correctly and efficiently and "execute" safely and comfortably is the responsibility of an excellent planning and control team. The planning and control team is divided into decision-making teams, planning teams, and control teams. The main goal of the decision-making and planning department is to find safe driving solutions in complex unmanned driving environments, such as analyzing human driving data to determine when to change lanes and whether to follow or detour to the vehicle ahead. The decision-making and planning part also learns human driving consensus from real road data, such as when to change lanes during traffic jams, how the following car should express whether it yields, and how to apply this consensus to specific algorithms. Additionally, decision-making and planning must be able to converge different futures into selected and determined behaviors. The control part is responsible for strictly executing these behaviors on the vehicle.

optimization based or search based path planning and trajectory generation
planning under uncertainty
probabilistic robotics
mobile or industrial robots
optimal control
C++ programming, data structures, and algorithms

When you come to us, you will find this is a professional, focused, interesting, and insightful team. Everyone comes together for an exciting and challenging goal, motivating each other and brainstorming, striving to realize product implementation, create social value, and advance industry technology. 
For ambitious engineers, what could be more meaningful than this? We stand by and sincerely look forward to highly skilled and like-minded friends joining us! 
For more information, please visit: http://www.weride.ai, or follow the official WeChat account: WeRide
Introduction to the PNC Group: 
In autonomous driving systems, decision-making, planning, and control can be likened to the human brain and nerves. Ensuring that the "brain and nerves" "think" correctly and efficiently and "execute" safely and comfortably is the responsibility of an excellent planning and control team. The planning and control team is divided into decision-making teams, planning teams, and control teams. The main goal of the decision-making and planning department is to find safe driving solutions in complex unmanned driving environments, such as analyzing human driving data to determine when to change lanes and whether to follow or detour to the vehicle ahead. The decision-making and planning part also learns human driving consensus from real road data, such as when to change lanes during traffic jams, how the following car should express whether it yields, and how to apply this consensus to specific algorithms. Additionally, decision-making and planning must be able to converge different futures into selected and determined behaviors. The control part is responsible for strictly executing these behaviors on the vehicle. 
Job Responsibilities: 
Responsible for designing and implementing autonomous driving decision-making modules to address the most challenging scenarios in autonomous driving
· How do driverless cars change lanes on crowded roads? How do you actively create lane change environments (such as accelerating lane changes); how do you accurately judge the intentions of vehicles beside you? How do you negotiate with other vehicles to force others to give way to you?
· Handle various reasonable or unreasonable behavioral scenarios, such as electric bikes driving against traffic, bicycles swaying side to side, and pedestrians weaving chaotically on the road
· Dealing with situations that violate traffic regulations but are very frequent: vehicles in adjacent lanes suddenly changing lanes to seize the right of way, continuous solid-line lane changes, and so on
· Decisions like congested highway merge make for human drivers
· Decisions regarding unmanned vehicle behavior under various traffic sign controls: such as how to pass through unprotected intersections, sidewalk behavior logic, and construction area passage logic
Job Requirements: 
· Proficient in programming and algorithm skills in one of C++, Python, or Java; Good engineering skills and coding style
· Familiar with several fields in computer science, with at least one area of insight, including but not limited to: algorithms, data structures, networks, architecture, compiler principles, statistical analysis; 
· Possesses strong logical thinking and self-motivation
· I hope you have strong motivation and genuine belief in autonomous driving
Bonus points: 
· Candidates with at least one background in machine learning, data mining, deep learning, statistics, optimization theory, automatic control, etc.; experience in related projects is preferred

Job Overview
TIER IV develops and operates Autoware, an open-source autonomous driving software, providing a wide range of applications, solutions, and services related to autonomous driving. 
Perception engineers are primarily responsible for developing technology that uses sensors installed in the vehicle to recognize traffic participants and stationary objects around the vehicle, which is one of the most important functions in Level 4 autonomous driving. 
Through development, evaluation, and benchmarking, we accumulate specialized Perception knowledge and address real-world challenges, aiming to accelerate autonomous driving development by making these technologies available internally and externally by making the results open.

- Contribution of autonomous driving technology to OSS

1022_Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Autonomous Driving End to End Model)
Job Overview
We are seeking machine learning experts for end-to-end autonomous driving technology development. 
[Background]
Tier4 develops and operates Autoware, an open-source autonomous driving software, offering a wide range of applications, solutions, and services related to autonomous driving. 
The End to End Machine Learning Engineer position is responsible for designing, implementing, training, and evaluating machine learning models for Autonomous Driving 2.0. You need rapid prototyping skills and expertise in the latest machine learning research. Additionally, since automotive ECUs often have limited computational resources, the goal is to develop machine learning models that deliver high performance while maintaining time constraints. 
[Job Description]
- Development of high-performance and robust end-to-end machine learning models for autonomous vehicles
- Surveys, reproducible implementations, and benchmarking of the latest papers
- Training, optimization, and implementation of machine learning models into automotive ECUs
- Data management (collection, sorting, preprocessing) for large-scale datasets, data quality improvement, and data pipeline construction
- Design and operation of learning infrastructure (MLOps, distributed learning, evaluation infrastructure) for end-to-end model training
- Contribution of autonomous driving technology to OSS
- Launched an open-source community for end-to-end machine learning models and collaborated with various communities and companies
[Challenges & Rewards]
Toward realizing an autonomous driving society, we are developing high-performance and robust end-to-end machine learning models. We are also making end-to-end machine learning models open-source, and we are establishing an open-source community for end-to-end machine learning models within the Autoware Foundation. 
[Reference Information]

1028_Senior Software Engineer, Autonomous Driving
Job Overview
[Background]
Under the mission of democratizing autonomous driving, TIER IV is releasing its autonomous driving software as open source while also developing it as a system built into vehicles. The autonomous driving technology cultivated in the research and demonstration phases has finally entered a new phase of mass production deployment across multiple vehicle platforms.

1103_Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
Job Overview
[Background]
At Tier IV, we are working on the development and operation of various foundations that support the introduction, operation, and development of autonomous driving systems, centered on the autonomous driving platform "Web.Auto," to realize a safer and more secure autonomous driving society. We are recruiting members to promote overall platform improvements and enhanced safety and reliability to promote the adoption of autonomous vehicles equipped with Autoware worldwide. 
[Job Description]
You will understand the system configuration, architecture, and development policies of the Autoware platform (Web.Auto), and are expected to address problem-solving, productivity improvement, and reliability assurance through all possible means without limiting your domain. 
Specifically, you will be engaged in the following tasks. Depending on your experience and aptitude, you will mainly be responsible for several of the following areas. 
Software Delivery
- Design and operation of deployment infrastructure that supports safe and rapid releases
- Creating mechanisms to reduce risks associated with releases (release gates, rollbacks, environment management, etc.)
- Improved observability and continuous improvement throughout the release process
Operation of Application Cloud Infrastructure
- Operation and performance improvement of application middleware
- Construction and operation of data stores, networks, etc. in the cloud
- Setup and support of Microservices infrastructure built on ECS / EKS / Lambda
Construction and operation of execution and learning platforms
- Infrastructure supporting the training and inference of machine learning models (such as cognition, judgment, and control)
- Utilization of HPC-related technologies such as GPU clusters, Slurm, Lustre, and InfiniBand
- Operation and optimization of computational, network, and storage infrastructure supporting large-scale distributed learning
Metric Design and Monitoring
- Evaluation of runtime performance and resource utilization efficiency
- Execution time, usage of computing resources including GPU, etc.
- Construction and operation of monitoring environments for fault detection and capacity planning
- Code quality evaluation
- Automated testing
- Database and visualization of evaluation results
Automation of operational tasks
- Development and operation of internal tools/scripts to automate and streamline operational tasks
- Utilization of generative AI (LLM, AI Agent)
- Incident response support, log analysis, operation document generation, etc.
International Expansion Support
- Infrastructure design and operation in compliance with local regulations
- Formulation and operation of deployment and data management strategies by region
Information Security
- Security design, vulnerability response, incident response
- Audit and compliance measures
Visualization and optimization of cloud costs
- Continuous improvement of cloud resource utilization efficiency
- Establishment of cost allocation and monitoring systems
[Challenges & Rewards]
- You can take on challenges in various technical fields (ECU, Mobile Network, IoT, Web, Container, Serverless, etc.). 
- As a platform supporting the global deployment of autonomous driving, it can continuously address technically and socially complex topics such as regulatory compliance, security requirements, and cost requirements in each region. 
- You can become a member of the 'social implementation of autonomous driving in the real world,' something no one has yet achieved.

1107_Backend Engineer, Data Platform
Job Overview
You will be responsible for developing and operating a data infrastructure that supports the collection, search, and analysis of data generated by autonomous driving. 
[Background]
At Tier IV, we have built a data infrastructure to collect, search, and analyze diverse and large-scale driving data toward realizing a safer and more secure autonomous driving society. The data platform is required to address various requirements such as the increase in data volume accompanying the spread of autonomous driving, aggregation and search of driving metrics and logs requiring real-time performance, automatic classification of driving scenes, and visualization of unstructured data (such as images and point clouds). 
Aiming for Tier IV's vision of "democratizing autonomous driving," we are recruiting members who can build a data infrastructure supporting globally used autonomous driving services and jointly deliver value to users. 
[Job Description]
You will be responsible for developing and operating a data infrastructure that supports the collection, search, and analysis of data generated by autonomous driving. 
- Development and operation of data pipelines to collect and process driving data from vehicles
- Development and operation of APIs that provide driving history and statistical information
- Development and operation of driving data visualization and search services
- Construction and operation of internal data analysis infrastructure
[Challenges & Rewards]
- Development of data pipelines that efficiently collect and process large volumes of driving metrics and logs, enabling near-real-time analysis
- Development of systems that process non-structured data such as images and point clouds, enabling search and visualization
- Achieving optimized data management costs through automatic analysis of large-scale driving data

1118_ Data Scaling - Data Operation Lead
Job Overview
[Background]
Autoware, the autonomous driving OSS led by Tier IV, is currently accelerating its adaptability and commercial deployment in diverse environments worldwide. The key to this growth lies in realizing advanced data operations that quickly adapt to local driving environments and enable stable and continuous operation into the future. 
This position plays a crucial role as the leader of continuous data collection and annotation processes, working closely with engineering departments such as perception and planning teams to support rapid and effective development from a data perspective. It is expected to build and operate a data supply pipeline that combines world-class quality, speed, and cost efficiency, accelerating the realization of an autonomous driving society. 
[Job Description]
- Strategic dataset construction process management
- Formulate annual plans and budgets for data collection and annotation based on the technology and product development roadmap
- Design and optimize end-to-end workflows for various data formats, including 2D/3D, time series data, synthetic data generated by generative AI, and multi-sensor fusion
- Global data building and partner management
- Selection, contracting, training, and evaluation systems for optimal domestic and international annotation vendors
- Managing business workflows across multiple vendors
- Formulation of technical guidelines and standard operating procedures
- Collaborate with various internal departments to formulate and update annotation specifications and manuals that meet the requirements for autonomous driving system development
- Verbalize the criteria for edge case judgment (special weather conditions, complex intersections, etc.) and accumulate them as intellectual assets within the organization. 
- Led the introduction and customization of annotation tools, improving work efficiency by integrating assist features such as Auto-Labeling
- Team building and development
- Lead a group consisting of annotation PMs, QA engineers, and others

At Tier IV, we are developing "Web.Auto" (https://web.auto/), which supports all aspects of introduction, operation, and development of autonomous driving systems toward realizing a safer and more secure autonomous driving society.

1128_Backend/IoT Engineer, OTA Platform
Job Overview
[Background]
Tier 4 is building an autonomous driving ecosystem centered on Autoware with the vision of "democratizing autonomous driving." Even after shipment, autonomous vehicles require continuous software updates to expand their driving range, improve functions, and address security issues, and delivering this safely and reliably to fleets of vehicles is an OTA (Over-The-Air) platform essential for commercial service. We are recruiting development members to design, promote, and evaluate the OTA infrastructure from the cloud to the automotive sector through E2E and further develop it. 
[Job Description]
You will be responsible for the backend of the OTA platform and the in-vehicle agent domain, demonstrating full-cycle ownership from requirements definition to operation. While focusing on either the backend and the automotive side, you are expected to cross boundaries with the other as well. 
- Design and development of OTA backends (cloud side)
- Campaign management, delivery orchestration, and gradual rollout/canary/rollback control
- Device fleet management, status synchronization, and metric collection
- Robust distribution mechanisms assuming unstable networks, including delta updates, resumpable downloads, and idempotency design
- Design and development of in-vehicle OTA agents (edge side)
- Implementation of OTA agent operating on automotive ECUs (Python / C++)
- Bidirectional communication with the cloud, download control, validation, application, and lifecycle management for rollback
- Collaboration with Autoware and other automotive components, A/B partition operation, secure boot integration
- Cloud ⇔ in-vehicle protocol design
- Bidirectional communication infrastructure centered on MQTT/AWS IoT Core
- Consistent design between campaign models and in-vehicle state machines
- Security/Reliability
- Signature verification, PKI, supply chain security
- SLO design and incident response, as well as collaborative operations with SRE teams
- Requirements definition with PdM/stakeholders and test design in collaboration with QA/QC teams
- Documentation such as user documentation and API references
[Challenges & Rewards]
- Without being confined to the web, you can seamlessly experience technical domains such as IoT, M2M, automotive embedded systems (Linux / C++), ROS/Autoware, from cloud to edge
- In "Web.Auto" (Web.Auto), which supports the introduction, operation, and development of autonomous driving centered on Autoware, you can take responsibility for developing core components that serve as hubs connecting the cloud and fleets.
- OTAs for edge devices like autonomous vehicles, where "failure is not allowed," have stricter fail-safe and security requirements than typical mobile/IoT OTAs, allowing them to tackle technically challenging challenges by designing both safety and agility from scratch.
- There is an opportunity to establish best practices and standards for OTA features in the autonomous driving market
- Able to tackle technically challenging challenges by designing the essential needs of diverse vehicle configurations, driving environments, and service forms as a highly versatile and adaptable renewal platform

1195_Senior Data Engineer / Data Platform Architect
Job Overview
[Background]
At Tier IV, we are building a large-scale data foundation to support the efficiency and quality improvement of autonomous driving system development toward the realization of "democratization of autonomous driving." Currently, the foundation for data collection from vehicles and search systems is progressing, but it is urgent to respond to the increasing volume of data, process streams in real time, and foster a culture of data utilization throughout the company. 
Until now, we have mainly focused on individual backend development, but we are now recruiting high-level engineers and architects who can lead company-wide data strategies from a medium- to long-term perspective, design and operate Data Lake and streaming processing, and build an organizational culture that enables data-driven decision-making. 
[Job Description]
As the technical lead for data infrastructure in autonomous driving development, you will lead everything from architecture design to organizational penetration. You are expected to go beyond simple function development, using generic analytical systems to reform inefficient internal business processes and create business impact. 
Specific Tasks
・Formulation of company-wide data strategy and architecture governance
- Lead technology selection and strategic decision-making for data platforms through participation in company-wide technical committees and architecture review boards. 
- Develop architecture policies based on data governance and security requirements and promote their adoption across the organization. 
- Based on the above strategy, lead the implementation of Data Lake and streaming processing platforms (AWS: Redshift, Glue, Kinesis, EMR, etc.) to achieve both scalability and cost efficiency. 
・Collaboration with management and business divisions, and solving business issues through data utilization
- Regularly form partnerships with heads of each business unit (BU) to propose and implement data-driven solutions to critical business challenges. 
- Beyond merely providing a foundation, we promote transformation of on-site business processes and the establishment of a company-wide data-driven decision making culture, together with stakeholders, including management. 
- Taking responsibility for the entire cycle from data to business impact, going beyond engineering. 
・Technical decision-making and raising engineering standards
- Exert strong influence over technology selection decisions based on advanced expertise, evaluating and improving existing architectures and practices. 
- Propose solutions as a Senior IC to cross-organizational technical challenges, driving the evolution of company-wide Data Standards and the standardization of best practices (DataOps/MLOps). 
- Enhance the technical capabilities of the entire development team through code reviews, architecture design reviews, and mentoring, promoting autonomous organizational growth. 
[Challenge - Sense of Purpose]
・Unprecedented Challenge with Large-Scale Data: Petabyte-scale data (images, point clouds, logs) generated by autonomous vehicles is incomparable in volume and complexity compared to typical web services. This is a rare opportunity to design architecture from scratch to efficiently process, search, and visualize this vast amount of unstructured data. 
・Experience in transforming organizations: You will not only provide technology but also foster a culture of data utilization within the company. By involving the business side and operations teams and leading the transformation into a data-driven organization, you can create significant business impact beyond engineering. 
・Direct contribution to an autonomous driving society: The data foundation we have built will directly contribute to safety verification of autonomous driving and improvements of AI models. You can work with a sense of accelerating the socially significant mission of "democratizing autonomous driving" with your own technology. 
・Technical Discretion and Pursuit of IC Careers: As a Senior IC, you can focus on technically challenging challenges without being overwhelmed by management duties as a manager. You have significant discretion in technology selection and architectural design, and can reflect your technical vision in your products.

[Background]
At Tier IV, with the vision of democratizing autonomous driving, we are advancing the development of the cloud-native DevOps platform "Web.Auto," which supports everything from the development of technology-based Web and IoT autonomous driving systems to construction, usage, and operation, in order to build an autonomous driving ecosystem. 
This position is seeking development leaders responsible for developing and operating edge infrastructure and middleware that securely connect in-vehicle systems (In-Car) and cloud (Out-Car / Web.Auto) with high reliability. You will lead everything from technology selection to architecture design, development leadership, and team management, playing a role in strengthening the foundation of the autonomous driving ecosystem. 
[Job Description]
First, as a member of the development team for the operation management platform, you will be responsible for the backend and in-vehicle agent areas, demonstrating full-cycle ownership from requirements definition to operation. While focusing on in-vehicle applications and infrastructure development (excluding Autoware) that communicate with Web.Auto, you are expected to also be involved in cloud-side development across the board. 
After that, you will lead the development team responsible for developing Web.Auto's functions and infrastructure across the automotive and cloud platforms. 
[Specific Job Examples]
- Design and development of in-vehicle Web.Auto Agents and cloud-side APIs
- Bidirectional communication with the cloud, download control, validation, application, and lifecycle management for rollback
- Cooperative operation with Autoware and other in-vehicle components
- Protocol design between cloud and automotive
- Building and operating a two-way communication infrastructure centered on MQTT/AWS IoT Core
- SLO design and incident response, as well as collaborative operations with SRE teams
- Requirements definition with PdM/stakeholders and test design in collaboration with QA/QC teams
- Collaborative development with cloud-side development teams
- User documentation, API references, and other documentation

- Experience in a wide range of technical fields, from IoT, M2M, ROS, to cloud infrastructure.

1203_Edge AI Engineer, Autonomous Driving
Job Overview
We are recruiting Edge AI engineers to help promote the integration of Perception technology into autonomous vehicles. 
[Background]
At Tier IV, we are promoting the "Co-MLOps" project as an initiative to scale up AI development for autonomous driving. Among these, we are working on developing recognition functions using Deep Neural Networks (DNN) as reference AI for autonomous driving. 
Running such DNNs requires massive computations, making high-performance hardware essential. However, automotive systems have thermal and power constraints, making it difficult to provide high-performance hardware to operate DNNs. 
To achieve both model weight reduction and low power consumption while improving recognition accuracy and robustness, we aim to fully understand the characteristics of hardware (AI processors) in in-vehicle systems and co-design and optimize DNN models to implement ultra-multilayered, high-precision models in automotive systems. 
[Job Description]
- Implementation of Deep Neural Networks (DNN) optimized for hardware characteristics such as GPUs, FPGAs, and AI Accelerators
- Development of lightweight DNNs aimed at low cost and low power and deployment of camera/LiDAR DNNs

1215_System Software Engineer, Real-time Performance
Job Overview
We are seeking talent to participate in research, software development, and system integration related to real-time performance or real-time constraint assurance of autonomous driving systems using Autoware. 
[Background]
Tier 4 develops and operates Autoware, an open-source autonomous driving software, offering a wide range of applications, solutions, and services related to autonomous driving. 
System Software Engineer - Real-time Performance is responsible for the real-time performance of autonomous driving systems powered by Autoware. Automated autonomous driving systems are modeled as complex data flows spanning CPUs and GPUs, with real-time constraints set for these data flows. Additionally, to leverage a rich ecosystem, Autoware is currently implemented on commercial hardware, Linux, and ROS 2. Unlike traditional real-time systems, due to the complexity of their models and hardware, OS, and middleware, there are many scientifically unresolved issues regarding real-time constraint assurance. We are responsible for research on these issues, software development based on research results, and even inputting them in autonomous driving products. 
[Job Description]
- Research and development on improving Autoware's real-time performance and guaranteeing real-time constraints (worst-case execution time estimation methods, scheduling algorithms, response time analysis methods, etc.)
- Software development based on research results (including system software development such as middleware, analysis tool development, Autoware development, and more, covering a wide range)
- Integration of developed methods and software with Autoware (including performance analysis and tuning kernel parameters, etc.). Depending on the situation, we may visit the actual vehicle testing site for autonomous driving and conduct experiments.
- Collaboration with the OSS community and information dissemination
- If desired, write papers or present in Japan and abroad
[Challenges & Rewards]
- From mass production projects promoted by TIER IV to autonomous driving projects worldwide using Autoware, the research and system software development he has been involved in supports various autonomous driving infrastructures. 
- You can be involved in everything from basic research on unsolved problems, to applying the results to software development, and even the gritty construction of autonomous driving systems that become actual social infrastructure. This is a valuable research and development site where it is essential to ensure value is reliably realized in the real world.

1216_SoC Hardware / Group Leader
Job Overview
[Background]
TIER IV offers a variety of applications, solutions, and services related to autonomous driving, centered around Autoware, an open-source autonomous driving software. 
Autonomous driving systems must simultaneously meet strict real-time constraints, power constraints, and functional safety requirements. To achieve this, it is essential not only to rely on general-purpose processors but also to design a coordinated design (hardware-software co-design) that integrates proprietary SoCs/accelerators optimized for autonomous driving workloads and the system software that runs them. 
TIER IV's compute platform development aims to design and integrate proprietary SoC/accelerators and autonomous driving development kits that meet low power consumption, real-time performance, and functional safety, optimizing Autoware's computing infrastructure through these hardware. In collaboration with domestic and international partners, we promote everything from specification formulation for SoC/accelerators, evaluation boards, and development kits to design, verification, prototyping, and actual device evaluation. 
We are seeking Group Leaders who will lead the hardware architecture of next-generation autonomous driving computing platforms to realize the vision of "democratizing autonomous driving." 
[Job Description]
As a Group Leader for Hardware/Architecture in compute platform development, you will be responsible for the following tasks. 
- SoC architecture review, specification formulation, design, and verification
- Microarchitecture study, specification formulation, design, and verification of proprietary accelerator IP
- Specification formulation, design, and verification of interfaces (LPDDR/PCIe/Ethernet/SPI/I2C/UART/SDIO, etc.)
- Formulation of validation strategies (UVM, assertion, formal validation, CDC/RDC, coverage, etc.) and definition and review of quality and sign-off criteria
- Definition of HW/SW interfaces in collaboration with System and Software groups (register specifications, memory maps, interrupts/DMA, performance/driver requirements)
- Hardware design and verification with functional safety in mind
- Collaborate with contractors for physical design (backend) to lead sign-off decisions as an internal technology owner
- Selection, contract, and management of prototype manufacturing contractors (including turnkey ones)
- Selection and contracting of EDA/IP vendors
- Specification formulation, design commissioning, and actual machine bling-up for evaluation boards and development kits
- Group policy formulation, assignment, progress management, and design quality control
Environment: Linux
Languages: SystemVerilog/Verilog, C/C++, etc.
EDA: Lint, logic synthesis, logic simulator, power estimation tools, etc.
Technologies: RISC-V, ARM, JTAG, PCIe, LPDDR, NoC, ISO 26262, etc.
Development support: AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Gemini
[Challenges & Rewards]
- As a technical leader, he will be involved in the entire workflow from specification formulation for proprietary SoC/accelerators designed specifically for autonomous driving, to logical and physical design, manufacturing, and actual device evaluation. 
- Participate daily in hardware development and related decision-making across a wide range of layers, including architecture, RTL, verification, physical design, evaluation boards, and development kits. 
- You can challenge yourself to create architectures that balance the inherently trade-off demands of low power consumption, real-time performance, and functional safety. 
- Deploy proprietary SoCs/accelerators developed in-house on computing platforms alongside general-purpose GPUs and other AI accelerators, leading cross-departmental development that optimizes PPA (Performance, Power, Area) through hardware-software collaboration. 
- As a Group Leader, you can balance organizational management with cutting-edge technology discussions, collaborating with global EDA/IP vendors and foundries as well as domestic and international partners.

[Background]
At Tier IV, to achieve its mission of democratizing autonomous driving, we open-source autonomous driving software and provide reference designs that integrate hardware (sensors, ECUs, vehicles) that meet the requirements of that software.

Under the slogan "Democratizing Autonomous Driving," Tier IV has developed Autoware, an open-source autonomous driving software, offering various solutions utilizing autonomous driving technology. 
Autonomous driving systems are systems where functions such as self-position estimation, obstacle detection, route planning, and vehicle control work together in tandem. To integrate such complex systems and deliver the expected functions and performance, engineers with advanced technical skills are essential. 
Therefore, our company is recruiting someone to serve as an integration engineer for autonomous driving systems.

- Setup of hardware (ECUs and communication devices) and OS/middleware that make up autonomous vehicle platforms, integration including software, function/performance verification, and quality improvement

1314_Software System Integration Engineer, Autonomous Driving
Job Overview
[Background]
TIER IV develops and operates the open-source autonomous driving software "Autoware," providing a variety of applications, solutions, and services related to autonomous driving. 
Autonomous driving systems are integrated systems where a wide range of technologies are intricately intertwined, from algorithms such as point clouds, image processing, self-position estimation, and control to elements like sensors, in-vehicle communication protocols, and networks. Building and operating such highly integrated systems requires expertise and interest not only in specific technical fields but also across a wide range of domains. 
Therefore, we seek engineers who can flexibly respond to a wide variety of technologies and systems and integrate efficiently. In addition, it is essential to have a motivation and curiosity to proactively learn and absorb knowledge even in unfamiliar fields. 
In addition to knowledge and integration skills related to autonomous driving, proactive and proactive efforts to improve the entire ecosystem, including the provision of autonomous driving services, involve many personnel such as development and evaluation teams. 
We are recruiting members who want to build systems that support globally used autonomous driving services and deliver value to users, in line with Tier 4's vision of "democratizing autonomous driving." 
[Job Description]
Based on the open-source autonomous driving software "Autoware," you will be responsible for the design, development, integration, and verification of autonomous driving systems and related services. 
Our mission is to flexibly customize Autoware and its surrounding tools (simulation environments, operation management systems, etc.) according to different deployment scenarios for each project, and to make autonomous vehicles "operate as a service." 
We also expect to standardize insights gained from the field and improve development efficiency and quality across the organization. 
Specific job responsibilities: 
- Selection of sensor configurations and technologies according to the implementation environment
- Setting up environments and middleware for automotive hardware
- Parameter tuning and function expansion of autonomous driving algorithms
- Verification, problem identification, and troubleshooting through actual driving and simulation
- Overall optimization of integration for service delivery
- Documentation of construction procedures and verification know-how, and sharing of knowledge internally
- Continuous improvement of development and implementation processes through automation of tasks and tool introduction
[Challenges & Rewards]
Under the vision of "democratizing autonomous driving," Tier IV develops practical autonomous driving services for a wide range of users. 
The mobility targets range from urban spaces to industrial sectors, including public transportation such as buses and taxis, as well as small mobile robots and transport robots within factories. 
The project phases are also diverse, from the PoC integration stage where autonomous vehicles are ready to operate using Autoware, to the productization phase polishing them to a service level, enabling deep involvement in every step of building and operating autonomous driving systems.
